classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论中的 Einstein 方程求解与数值相对论应用，属于用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论支线；未涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2609.39087v1.title: Primordial Tensor Signatures and Gravitational Wave Constraints in Lorentz Violating Inflation with Non-Canonical Kinetics
2609.39087v1.abstract: We investigate primordial tensor perturbations in a Lorentz violating inflationary framework with non-canonical scalar field dynamics. Using an Einstein-\AE{}ther type with a higher order kinetic term $K_3X^2$, we derive the tensor propagation speed and its dependence on an effective Lorentz violating coupling. We consider an analytically tractable potential free background and study two representative couplings, $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^2$ and $q_k=\lambda_T\phi_k^4$. The resulting tensor spectral index $n_T$ and its running $\alpha_T$ satisfy distinct consistency relations, providing potential signatures of Lorentz violation in the primordial gravitational wave spectrum. We derive corresponding constraints from the tensor tilt and running and compare them with the stringent late-time bound on the gravitational wave speed from GW170817/GRB170817A. We emphasize that translating this bound into primordial constraint requires an assumption about the evolution of tensor sector coupling between inflation and the late Universe. Our results demonstrate that primordial tensor observables can provide a complementary probe of Lorentz violation and its interplay with non-canonical inflationary dynamics.

classification.title_zh: 洛伦兹破坏暴胀中非正则动能的原初张量特征与引力波约束
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究洛伦兹破坏暴胀框架中带非正则标量场动力学的原初张量扰动。采用含高阶动能项 K3X^2 的爱因斯坦-以太型理论，导出张量传播速度及其对有效洛伦兹破坏耦合的依赖。我们考虑一个可解析处理的无势背景，并研究两种代表性耦合 q_k=λ_T φ_k^2 和 q_k=λ_T φ_k^4。所得张量谱指数 n_T 及其跑动 α_T 满足不同的一致性关系，为原初引力波谱中的洛伦兹破坏提供潜在特征。我们导出张量倾斜和跑动对应的约束，并将其与 GW170817/GRB170817A 给出的晚期引力波速度严格限制比较。我们强调，将该限制转化为原初约束需要对张量扇区耦合从暴胀到晚期宇宙的演化作出假设。结果表明，原初张量观测量可为洛伦兹破坏及其与非正则暴胀动力学的相互作用提供互补探针。
classification.one_liner: 在含非正则动能和爱因斯坦-以太型洛伦兹破坏的暴胀模型中，导出张量传播速度、谱指数与跑动的一致性关系，并讨论原初引力波约束及 GW170817 限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学/经典引力与引力波约束支线，涉及爱因斯坦-以太型修正引力及原初张量扰动，但不属于全息对偶研究。

2609.39186v1.title: Black Holes With Complete Asymptotic Throats
2609.39186v1.abstract: We investigate whether a spherically symmetric black hole can have a complete inner end at finite, nonzero areal radius while satisfying the standard energy conditions sufficiently far outside its horizon. Retaining two independent metric functions, we treat both null-type and spacelike-type asymptotic throats and derive a necessary and sufficient integral criterion for causal geodesic completeness. Under boundedness and finite-limit assumptions on the independent curvature components, null-type ends have limiting curvature fixed by the throat radius, whereas spacelike-type ends admit an additional nonnegative curvature parameter. We obtain criteria for bounded curvature in timelike and null parallel-propagated frames. Complete spacelike-type examples can have bounded scalar invariants and bounded timelike-frame curvature but unbounded null-frame curvature at infinite affine parameter. We also prove that the radial null energy condition must fail arbitrarily close to every complete inner end in the stated class. Nevertheless, explicit real-analytic constructions with either type of throat satisfy the null, weak, dominant, and strong energy conditions throughout a sufficiently distant exterior region. Smooth constructions can become exactly Schwarzschild beyond a finite radius. These results establish the compatibility of complete asymptotic throats with exterior energy conditions while distinguishing completeness from different levels of curvature regularity.

classification.title_zh: 具有完备渐近喉的黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一个球对称黑洞能否在有限非零面积半径处具有完备内端，同时在其视界外足够远处满足标准能量条件。保留两个独立的度规函数，我们处理零类（null-type）和类空型（spacelike-type）渐近喉，并推导因果测地线完备性的一个必要且充分积分判据。在对独立曲率分量有有界性和有限极限假设下，零类型端点的极限曲率由喉半径固定，而类空类型端点允许一个额外的非负曲率参数。我们得到了在类时和零类平行传播标架中曲率有界的判据。完备的类空类型例子可以有有界标量不变量和有界类时标架曲率，但在无限仿射参数处零标架曲率无界。我们还证明，在所陈述类别中，径向零能量条件必须在每个完备内端任意近处失效。然而，具有任一种喉的显式实解析构造在足够远的外部区域处处满足零、弱、主和强能量条件。光滑构造可以在有限半径之外变成精确的 Schwarzschild。这些结果确立了完备渐近喉与外部能量条件的相容性，同时区分完备性与不同层次的曲率正则性。
classification.one_liner: 该文证明球对称黑洞可在视界外满足标准能量条件的同时拥有完备渐近内喉，给出测地线完备性判据，并指出径向零能量条件在完备内端附近必被违反。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典广义相对论中的球对称黑洞、渐近喉、能量条件与测地线完备性，直接匹配重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.39583v1.title: MADGRAV: a multilevel anomaly-detection pipeline for gravitational-wave searches applied to LIGO data
2609.39583v1.abstract: We present the results of \textbf{MADGRAV}, a deep-learning-based search for high-mass compact binary coalescences, applied to the data collected by the LIGO interferometers during the third observing run and during the first and second part of the fourth observing run. The \textbf{MADGRAV} pipeline consists of a series of sequential convolutional neural networks that perform anomaly detection, glitch classification, coherence testing, and signal ranking. Data from the Hanford and Livingston LIGO detectors are studied (both individually and in coherence) by way of 1 second Q-transform windows. Of the candidates that survive every stage of the pipeline, 48 reach the significance threshold, and we report 47 gravitational wave detections characterised by a false alarm rate below $1\,{\rm yr}^{-1}$ with a probability of astrophysical origin $p_{\rm astro}>0.9$. Of the 47 detections, 44 are shared with the minimally modelled coherent WaveBurst search. The observed total source-frame masses, extracted from official gravitational wave transient catalogues, are in the $14-236 M_{\odot}$ range with a median of $69 M_{\odot}$, and a median SNR of 16. We note that the recovered fraction of confident detections rises with mass: for LIGO detectors network SNR $>10$ the pipeline recovers $8.1\%$ of confident catalog events below $30 M_{\odot}$, $39.8\%$ between $30$ and $100 M_{\odot}$, and $53.3\%$ above $100 M_{\odot}$, corresponding to $33.3\%$, $45.5\%$ and $53.3\%$ of the events detected by coherent WaveBurst in the same bins. These results suggest that anomaly detection pipelines can serve as an independent detection channel complementary to matched filtering in the high-mass high-SNR regime.

classification.title_zh: MADGRAV：应用于 LIGO 数据的引力波搜索多级异常检测流程
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了 MADGRAV 的结果，这是一个基于深度学习的高质量致密双星并合搜索，应用于 LIGO 干涉仪在第三次观测运行以及第四次观测运行第一、第二部分收集的数据。MADGRAV 流程由一系列顺序卷积神经网络组成，执行异常检测、毛刺分类、相干性检验和信号排序。我们通过 1 秒 Q 变换窗口研究 Hanford 和 Livingston LIGO 探测器的数据（分别以及相干）。在通过流程每一阶段的候选者中，48 个达到显著性阈值，我们报告了 47 个引力波探测，其虚警率低于 1 yr^-1，天体物理来源概率 p_astro>0.9。47 个探测中有 44 个与最小模型化相干 WaveBurst 搜索共享。从官方引力波瞬变目录提取的观测总源帧质量范围为 14–236 M_sun，中位数为 69 M_sun，中位信噪比为 16。我们注意到，回收的置信探测比例随质量上升：对于 LIGO 探测器网络 SNR>10，该流程回收 30 M_sun 以下置信目录事件的 8.1%，30–100 M_sun 之间的 39.8%，100 M_sun 以上的 53.3%，分别对应相干 WaveBurst 在同一区间探测事件的 33.3%、45.5% 和 53.3%。这些结果表明，异常检测流程可以作为独立探测通道，在高质量高信噪比区域补充匹配滤波。
classification.one_liner: MADGRAV 深度学习异常检测流程在 LIGO O3/O4 数据中报告 47 个高置信引力波探测，并显示在高质量区可作为匹配滤波的补充通道。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波观测与数据分析，与用户经典引力支线相关；但不涉及全息、量子引力或量子信息理论，且方法偏探测流程而非引力理论本身。

2609.39664v1.title: Spherical thin shells with charge in unimodular gravity
2609.39664v1.abstract: We construct spherically symmetric thin shells in unimodular gravity (UG) and analyze their dynamical stability under radial, symmetry-preserving perturbations. We use the UG junction conditions and adopt non-conservative charged exterior solutions sourced by a radial electric field. As an application, we build charged vacuum bubbles: a Minkowski interior surrounded by a charged thin shell and matched to an exterior UG geometry. The resulting spacetimes are free of event horizons and central singularities, while in de Sitter-like cases a cosmological horizon may exist outside the shell. We compare the stability regions and the matter content with their counterparts in general relativity, finding some differences controlled by the UG non-conservation parameter. This work extends previously published results.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 幺模引力中带电荷的球对称薄壳
classification.abstract_zh: 我们在幺模引力（UG）中构造球对称薄壳，并在径向、保持对称性的微扰下分析其动力学稳定性。我们使用 UG 连接条件，并采用由径向电场源产生的非守恒带电外部解。作为一个应用，我们构建带电真空泡：内部为 Minkowski 时空，外部由带电薄壳包围并匹配到 UG 外部几何。所得时空无事件视界和中心奇点，而在类 de Sitter 情形中壳外可能存在宇宙学视界。我们将稳定性区域和物质内容与广义相对论中的对应结果进行比较，发现一些由 UG 非守恒参数控制的差异。本工作扩展了此前发表的结果。
classification.one_liner: 在幺模引力中构造带电球对称薄壳与真空泡，分析其径向稳定性并与广义相对论比较。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/修改引力中的薄壳与气泡稳定性，非全息研究；但与经典引力及气泡/稳定性重点支线相关。

2609.39864v1.title: Testing charged bumblebee black holes through high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations in X-ray binaries
2609.39864v1.abstract: We investigate strong-field orbital dynamics for static spherically symmetric charged bumblebee black holes featuring spontaneous Lorentz-violating effects. Analysis of null and timelike circular geodesics yields the photon-sphere radius, the innermost stable circular orbit (ISCO) radius, and characteristic orbital frequencies for test particles. Within the relativistic precession model for high-frequency quasi-periodic oscillations (HFQPOs), observed twin-peak frequencies are governed by the full set of fundamental parameters $M$, $X=r/M$, $l_1$, $l_2$, and $Q_0/M$. Among them, $l_1$, $l_2$, and $Q_0/M$ enter frequency expressions only in combined forms, giving rise to intrinsic parameter degeneracy. An effective-parameter set $\Theta=(M,X,C,\beta)$ is accordingly introduced to characterize these composite contributions. Bayesian MCMC parameter inference is carried out using HFQPO observational data from three black-hole X-ray binaries: GRO J1655--40, XTE J1550--564, and GRS 1915+105. The 68\% credible intervals of composite parameter $C$ all contain the Reissner--Nordstr\"om limit $C=1$, revealing no statistically significant net Lorentz-violating correction under our model assumptions. Distinct triples $(l_1,l_2,Q_0/M)$ yield identical QPO predictions, so HFQPO observations alone cannot disentangle Lorentz-violating and charge-related effects; precise constraints on these fundamental quantities require additional, more precise observational data.

classification.title_zh: 通过 X 射线双星中的高频准周期振荡检验带电 bumblebee 黑洞
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有自发洛伦兹破缺效应的静态球对称带电 bumblebee 黑洞的强场轨道动力学。对零测地线和类时圆轨道的分析给出了光子球半径、最内稳定圆轨道（ISCO）半径以及试验粒子的特征轨道频率。在高频准周期振荡（HFQPOs）的相对论进动模型中，观测到的双峰频率由全部基本参数 M、X=r/M、l1、l2 和 Q0/M 决定。其中 l1、l2 和 Q0/M 仅以组合形式进入频率表达式，导致内禀参数简并。因此引入有效参数集 Θ=(M,X,C,β) 来刻画这些组合贡献。我们使用三个黑洞 X 射线双星 GRO J1655--40、XTE J1550--564 和 GRS 1915+105 的 HFQPO 观测数据进行贝叶斯 MCMC 参数推断。复合参数 C 的 68% 可信区间均包含 Reissner--Nordström 极限 C=1，表明在我们模型假设下没有统计显著的净洛伦兹破缺修正。不同的三元组 (l1,l2,Q0/M) 给出相同的 QPO 预言，因此仅凭 HFQPO 观测无法区分洛伦兹破缺效应与电荷相关效应；对这些基本量的精确限制需要额外、更精确的观测数据。
classification.one_liner: 在带电 bumblebee 黑洞时空中计算强场轨道频率，并用 X 射线双星 HFQPO 数据做贝叶斯限制，未发现显著洛伦兹破缺修正。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究修改引力黑洞强场轨道与 QPO 观测限制；不涉及全息对偶、量子信息、全息凝聚态或 QNM 非线性演化。

2609.40243v1.title: Flat limit of artificial cosmology for scalar waves in Schwarzschild-de Sitter
2609.40243v1.abstract: How do cosmological waveforms approximate waveforms from isolated systems for a small cosmological constant? This question is motivated by the observed small value of the cosmological constant, and also by Misner's idea to regulate the formally singular terms introduced into the Einstein equations by conformal compactification. We investigate this question quantitatively using scalar waves on Schwarzschild--de Sitter backgrounds. A suitable flat limit requires the foliation to remain regular at the future conformal boundary. We compare bridge foliations extending from the black hole horizon to the cosmological horizon with a regular asymptotically flat limit. Comparisons of cosmological and asymptotically flat waveforms on geometrically matched data show that the flat limit is numerically well behaved and recovers the essential features of the asymptotically flat waveform. We extend Misner's artificial cosmology by introducing a cosmological source that leaves the near-zone geometry unchanged and show that it improves agreement of the ringdown waveform but fails to capture the intermediate polynomial tail behavior accurately.

classification.title_zh: Schwarzschild-de Sitter 中标量波人工宇宙学的平直极限
classification.abstract_zh: 当宇宙学常数很小时，宇宙学波形如何近似孤立系统的波形？这个问题由观测到的很小的宇宙学常数，以及 Misner 通过共形紧致化调节爱因斯坦方程中形式上奇异项的思想所驱动。我们使用 Schwarzschild--de Sitter 背景上的标量波定量研究这个问题。一个合适的平直极限要求叶状结构在未来共形边界处保持正则。我们将从黑洞视界延伸到宇宙学视界的桥式叶状结构与一个正则的渐近平直极限进行比较。在几何匹配的数据上比较宇宙学与渐近平直波形表明，平直极限在数值上表现良好，并恢复了渐近平直波形的基本特征。我们通过引入一个不改变近区几何的宇宙学源来扩展 Misner 的人工宇宙学，并表明它改善了 ringdown 波形的一致性，但未能准确捕捉中间的多项式尾行为。
classification.one_liner: 在 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 上定量检验标量波宇宙学波形的小宇宙学常数平直极限，并扩展 Misner 人工宇宙学。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究经典引力中的 Schwarzschild-de Sitter 标量波、平直极限与 ringdown/尾行为，匹配经典引力/广义相对论及 QNM 相关重点支线；不涉及全息。

2609.38292v1.title: On Gauge Gravity's 'Hypermomentum Challenge' to the Geometric Trinity
2609.38292v1.abstract: Claims concerning a dynamical equivalence between general relativity and two reformulations of it, in which gravity is encoded in torsion and non-metricity respectively, have attracted some attention. If taken to be true, this 'Geometric Trinity' suggests that it is impossible to determine, even in principle, whether one inhabits a spacetime solution possessing curvature, torsion or non-metricity (insofar as the probes of geometry are paths of test particles). This claim is in direct tension with the long tradition of studying gravity as a gauge theory, in which distinct geometric attributes couple to distinct properties of matter (such as energy-momentum to curvature and spin angular momentum to torsion). In this short paper, I compare these two conflicting frameworks for geometrizing spacetime and describe the precise source, nature and implications of their disagreement. The equivalence claim holds only under a substantive restriction on the matter sector, namely that matter does not couple to an independent affine connection. Because the relevant couplings remain beyond current empirical reach, the choice between the frameworks turns on a trade-off among ontological, epistemic, and methodological forms of parsimony.

classification.title_zh: 论规范引力对“几何三位一体”的“超动量挑战”
classification.abstract_zh: 关于广义相对论与其两种重新表述（分别将引力编码在挠率和非度规性中）之间存在动力学等价性的主张已引起一些关注。若该主张成立，这一“几何三位一体”意味着，即使在原则上也无法确定一个人所处的时空解究竟具有曲率、挠率还是非度规性（就几何的探针是测试粒子路径而言）。该主张与将引力视为规范理论的悠久传统直接冲突，后者中不同的几何属性耦合到物质的不同属性（例如能动张量耦合到曲率，自旋角动量耦合到挠率）。在这篇短文中，我比较这两种相互冲突的时空几何化框架，并描述其分歧的确切来源、性质与含义。等价性主张仅在物质部分受到实质性限制时才成立，即物质不耦合到独立的仿射联络。由于相关耦合仍超出当前经验范围，两种框架之间的选择取决于本体论、认识论和方法论简约性之间的权衡。
classification.one_liner: 本文辨析广义相对论与挠率/非度规表述的“几何三位一体”等价性主张，指出其依赖物质不耦合独立仿射联络的限制，并与规范引力中不同几何属性耦合不同物质属性的图景冲突。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论的基础与概念研究，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或所列举的全息研究支线，因此与全息分类任务的相关性为中等。

2609.38399v1.title: Fisher and DALI posterior approximations for testing gravity with gravitational waves
2609.38399v1.abstract: We investigate the accuracy and computational efficiency of posterior approximations for gravitational-wave (GW) parameter estimation based on Fisher Matrix and its higher-order extension, the Derivative Approximation for LIkelihoods (DALI), in the context of tests of General Relativity using parameterized deviations in the inspiral waveforms (the TIGER formalism). We adopt the \texttt{IMRPhenomD} waveform and compare the exact posterior sampling to the following approximations in increasing order of complexity: the traditional Fisher Matrix, the Fisher sampling (singlet-DALI), the doublet-DALI and the triplet-DALI. We find that both singlet and doublet-DALI are significantly faster than the exact posterior by factors between 20 and 1000, depending on the inspiral SNRs -- larger gains correspond to larger SNRs. These gains are considerably larger for more complete waveforms, such as \texttt{IMRPhenomHM}. To evaluate the accuracy of the approximations, we use Jensen-Shannon divergence. We conclude that both singlet and doublet-DALI systematically improves over the standard Fisher Matrix approximation, while triplet-DALI shows large variability, limiting its practical advantage. We also introduce a code with a new implementation of Fisher and DALI analysis (Symbolic DALI, \texttt{SymDALI}) which computes derivatives symbolically via \textit{Wolfram Language}.

classification.title_zh: 利用引力波检验引力的 Fisher 与 DALI 后验近似
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在利用 inspiral 波形中的参数化偏离（TIGER 形式）检验广义相对论时，基于 Fisher 矩阵及其高阶扩展 DALI（Derivative Approximation for LIkelihoods）的后验近似在引力波参数估计中的精度与计算效率。我们采用 IMRPhenomD 波形，并将精确后验采样与按复杂度递增的以下近似进行比较：传统 Fisher 矩阵、Fisher 采样（singlet-DALI）、doublet-DALI 和 triplet-DALI。我们发现 singlet-DALI 和 doublet-DALI 都比精确后验显著更快，加速因子在 20 到 1000 之间，取决于 inspiral 信噪比——信噪比越大增益越大。对于更完整的波形（如 IMRPhenomHM），这些增益更大。为评估近似精度，我们使用 Jensen-Shannon 散度。我们得出结论：singlet-DALI 和 doublet-DALI 都系统性地优于标准 Fisher 矩阵近似，而 triplet-DALI 表现出较大波动，限制了其实际优势。我们还发布了一个包含 Fisher 和 DALI 分析新实现的代码（Symbolic DALI, SymDALI），它通过 Wolfram Language 符号计算导数。
classification.one_liner: 比较 Fisher 矩阵与 DALI 高阶后验近似在引力波参数估计和广义相对论检验中的精度与效率，并发布符号计算代码 SymDALI。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”，主题为引力波参数估计与广义相对论检验；但不属于全息或量子引力方向。

2609.38422v1.title: AdS - de Sitter transition in interacting dark energy models
2609.38422v1.abstract: Recent cosmological results, including the persistent $H_0$ tension and indications of dynamical dark energy, have raised the possibility that the standard $\Lambda$-Cold Dark Matter ($\Lambda$CDM) model may be incomplete. At the same time, theoretical developments based on swampland conjectures indicate that the realization of a stable de Sitter vacuum within string theory is challenging. Motivated by these observational and theoretical considerations, we investigate an interacting $\Lambda$ scenario characterized by a general linear coupling in the dark sector. At the background level, this model naturally allows the dark energy density to evolve from negative to positive values, opening the possibility of a transition from an anti-de Sitter-like phase to the de Sitter-like phase inferred by current observations. We derive the analytic background solutions and perturbation equations, discuss the physically acceptable region of parameter space, and constrain the model with DES-Dovekie type Ia supernovae, DESI BAO and CMB data. Our analysis suggests a parameter space allowing the dark energy density to change sign while maintaining positive dark matter density, motivating further investigation of an interaction-driven anti-de Sitter to de Sitter transition.

classification.title_zh: 相互作用暗能量模型中的 AdS-de Sitter 转变
classification.abstract_zh: 近期宇宙学结果，包括持续存在的 H0 张力以及动力学暗能量的迹象，提出了标准 Λ-冷暗物质（ΛCDM）模型可能不完整的可能性。与此同时，基于沼泽地猜想的理论发展表明，在弦理论中实现稳定的 de Sitter 真空具有挑战性。受这些观测和理论考虑启发，我们研究了一种相互作用 Λ 情景，其特征是暗扇区具有一般线性耦合。在背景层面，该模型自然允许暗能量密度从负值演化到正值，从而开启从类反 de Sitter 相到当前观测所推断的类 de Sitter 相转变的可能性。我们推导了解析背景解和微扰方程，讨论了参数空间中物理可接受的区域，并用 DES-Dovekie 型 Ia 超新星、DESI BAO 和 CMB 数据约束该模型。我们的分析表明，存在允许暗能量密度改变符号同时保持正暗物质密度的参数空间，这促使进一步研究相互作用驱动的反 de Sitter 到 de Sitter 转变。
classification.one_liner: 研究相互作用暗能量模型，使暗能量密度由负变正，实现类 AdS 到类 dS 的宇宙学转变，并用超新星、BAO 和 CMB 数据约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文在经典引力/宇宙学框架下研究相互作用暗能量及 AdS-dS 转变，并做宇宙学微扰与观测约束；它不属于 AdS/CFT 全息对偶，但与经典引力/广义相对论支线的宇宙学应用相关。

2609.38508v1.title: Relativistic Spherical Accretion in Nonrotating Black Hole Spacetimes: Astrophysical Implications
2609.38508v1.abstract: We present a systematic analysis of spherically symmetric accretion flows onto thirteen non-rotating black hole spacetimes, including charged and regular black holes, scalar and dilaton fields, dark energy, cosmological constants, modified gravity, and parametrized metrics. We generalize the Michel solution to arbitrary diagonal spacetimes and investigate the density, temperature, velocity, Mach number, mass accretion rate, and bremsstrahlung luminosity equilibrium profiles. Using the Schwarzschild solution as a reference, we find significant deviations in the accretion flow, with cosmological-constant and dark-energy models strongly suppressing accretion, while regular and Yukawa-like spacetimes generally enhance it. We provide fitting formulas for the accretion rates and luminosities as functions of the spacetime parameters. We then explore two astrophysical applications: accretion onto supermassive black holes, such as Sgr A* and M87*, and the inferred progenitor masses of the intermediate-mass black holes associated with the GW190521 gravitational wave event. We find that observational uncertainties may allow us to probe signatures of deviations from the Schwarzschild spacetime.

classification.title_zh: 非旋转黑洞时空中的相对论球对称吸积：天体物理启示
classification.abstract_zh: 我们系统分析了十三种非旋转黑洞时空上的球对称吸积流，包括带电黑洞和正规黑洞、标量场和膨胀子场、暗能量、宇宙学常数、修改引力以及参数化度规。我们将 Michel 解推广到任意对角时空，并研究了密度、温度、速度、马赫数、质量吸积率和轫致辐射光度的平衡剖面。以 Schwarzschild 解为参照，我们发现吸积流存在显著偏离：宇宙学常数和暗能量模型强烈抑制吸积，而正规黑洞和类 Yukawa 时空通常增强吸积。我们给出了吸积率和光度作为时空参数函数的拟合公式。随后我们探讨了两个天体物理应用：超大质量黑洞（如 Sgr A* 和 M87*）上的吸积，以及与 GW190521 引力波事件相关的中等质量黑洞的推断前身质量。我们发现，观测不确定性可能允许我们探测偏离 Schwarzschild 时空的特征。
classification.one_liner: 将 Michel 球对称吸积解推广到十三类非旋转黑洞时空，并评估其对吸积率、光度及天体物理观测的影响。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究经典黑洞时空中的相对论球对称吸积及天体物理应用，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT、量子引力或全息对偶。

2609.39057v1.title: Improved Population and EOS Joint Inference for Binary Neutron Star Systems
2609.39057v1.abstract: The extreme environment within neutron stars presents the opportunity to probe the nuclear equation of state at high densities while studying the properties of these stellar remnants. Historically, the equation of state and neutron star mass distribution have been inferred separately, with the latter often simply assumed to be fixed in studies of the former, but the dependence of the equation of state on neutron star mass indicates they should be inferred together. In this work, we extend the generalized version of the popular RIFT algorithm known as Hyperpipe to interface with flexible, user-provided priors that will facilitate joint inference of equation of state and binary neutron star population hyperparameters. We demonstrate this framework's utility via application to a combination of several existing observations, particularly including massive galactic pulsars, double neutron star systems, millisecond X-ray pulsars, the gravitational wave event GW170817 and the nuclear symmetry energy, within the context of a widely-adopted parametric EOS family and a simple Gaussian population model. We recover parameters consistent with previous analyses of the EOS and binary neutron star population, finding the latter to fit a bivariate normal distribution with mean $(\mu_1,\mu_2) = (1.39,1.27) M_{\odot}$ and width $\sigma = 0.08 M_{\odot}$. Furthermore, we implement novel coordinate transformations in our pipeline, with which we have discovered that the ad hoc prior boundaries used for this EOS family may be too restrictive. We present results with relaxed yet still physical prior boundaries, noting vastly improved hyperparameter posteriors and modestly different equation of state inferences.

classification.title_zh: 双中子星系统的改进族群与状态方程联合推断
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星内部的极端环境为在高密度下探测核状态方程，同时研究这些恒星遗迹的性质提供了机会。历史上，状态方程与中子星质量分布通常被分别推断，后者在状态方程研究中常被简单固定，但状态方程对中子星质量的依赖表明二者应联合推断。在本工作中，我们将流行 RIFT 算法的广义版本 Hyperpipe 扩展为可与灵活的、用户提供的先验接口，以促进状态方程与双中子星族群超参数的联合推断。我们通过将该框架应用于若干现有观测的组合来展示其效用，特别包括大质量银河系脉冲星、双中子星系统、毫秒 X 射线脉冲星、引力波事件 GW170817 以及核对称能，并在广泛采用的参数化 EOS 族和简单高斯族群模型背景下进行。我们复原的参数与先前对 EOS 和双中子星族群的推断一致，后者符合均值 (μ1, μ2) = (1.39, 1.27) M☉、宽度 σ = 0.08 M☉ 的二元正态分布。此外，我们在流程中实现了新的坐标变换，并据此发现该 EOS 族所用的事先设定的先验边界可能过于严格。我们给出了使用放宽但仍具物理性的先验边界的结果，并注意到超参数后验显著改善，而状态方程推断有适度差异。
classification.one_liner: 扩展 Hyperpipe 以联合推断中子星状态方程与双中子星族群超参数，并发现常用 EOS 先验边界可能过窄。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/引力波与致密星观测推断，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

2210.01574v2.title: Charged anisotropic white dwarfs in $f\left({R}, {T}\right)$ gravity
2210.01574v2.abstract: In the framework of $f(R, T) = R + 2 \beta T$ gravity, wherein $R$ denotes the Ricci scalar and $T$ represents the trace of the energy-momentum tensor, the equilibrium structure of charged anisotropic white dwarfs is investigated. The stellar equations for the general scenario are derived, and numerical solutions are obtained for the Chandrasekhar equation of state alongside the charge density distribution proportional to the energy density, $\rho_{\mathrm{ch}} = \alpha \rho$. By scrutinizing the properties of the solutions under various parameter combinations, we conducted an exhaustive analysis of the influences of electric charge, modified gravity, and anisotropy on the structural characteristics of white dwarfs. Crucially, white dwarfs can transcend the trivial instances of General Relativity in various ways, thereby demonstrating super-Chandrasekhar phenomena. As an inquiry into the structure of white dwarfs, the findings of this research may contribute to elucidating astronomical observations such as superluminous type Ia supernovae.

classification.title_zh: f(R,T)引力中的带电各向异性白矮星
classification.abstract_zh: 在 f(R,T)=R+2βT 引力框架下，其中 R 为 Ricci 标量，T 为能动量张量的迹，研究了带电各向异性白矮星的平衡结构。推导了一般情形下的恒星结构方程，并针对 Chandrasekhar 状态方程以及电荷密度分布与能量密度成正比 ρ_ch=αρ 的情形获得数值解。通过考察不同参数组合下解的性质，全面分析了电荷、修改引力和各向异性对白矮星结构特征的影响。关键的是，白矮星能够以多种方式超越广义引力的平庸情形，从而展现超 Chandrasekhar 现象。作为对白矮星结构的研究，这些结果可能有助于解释超亮 Ia 型超新星等天文观测。
classification.one_liner: 在 f(R,T) 引力中研究带电各向异性白矮星，发现其可超越广义相对论情形并出现超 Chandrasekhar 现象。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典/修改引力与致密星结构研究，不属于全息或量子引力；与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”支线相关。

2604.01407v4.title: High-frequency gravitational wave transients from superradiance
2604.01407v4.abstract: Ultralight bosons can form macroscopic gravitational-atom clouds around rotating black holes via superradiance, sourcing quasi-monochromatic gravitational waves through level transitions and annihilation. Primordial black holes provide a natural setting for such systems in a frequency range relevant for resonant-cavity experiments. We present a unified treatment of gravitational-wave emission from both isolated and binary-perturbed gravitational atoms in this regime. For isolated systems, we derive analytic expressions for the time- and frequency-domain strain from transition and annihilation channels, emphasizing their narrow-band structure. For binaries, we model resonantly driven level transitions using the Landau--Zener formalism and compute the resulting transient signals. We find that, while binary-driven transitions generically yield signals with durations compatible with detector response times, their characteristic strain lies well below the sensitivity of current experiments at astrophysically plausible distances, and event rates further suppress detectability by requiring sources at unrealistically small separations. We quantify the improvements in sensitivity, bandwidth, and response needed to render these signals observable, and identify gravitational-atom systems around primordial black holes as a theoretically well-motivated target for future high-frequency gravitational-wave searches.

classification.title_zh: 超辐射产生的高频引力波暂现信号
classification.abstract_zh: 超轻玻色子可以通过超辐射在旋转黑洞周围形成宏观的引力原子云，并通过能级跃迁和湮灭产生准单色引力波。原初黑洞为这类系统提供了一个自然场景，其频率范围与共振腔实验相关。我们对该区域中孤立和双星扰动引力原子的引力波辐射给出统一处理。对于孤立系统，我们推导了来自跃迁和湮灭通道的时域和频域应变的解析表达式，强调其窄带结构。对于双星系统，我们用 Landau--Zener 形式模拟共振驱动的能级跃迁，并计算由此产生的暂现信号。我们发现，虽然双星驱动的跃迁通常产生持续时间与探测器响应时间相容的信号，但在天体物理上合理的距离处，其特征应变远低于当前实验的灵敏度，而且事件率进一步通过要求源处于不切实际的小间距而抑制可探测性。我们量化了使这些信号可观测所需的灵敏度、带宽和响应方面的改进，并指出原初黑洞周围的引力原子系统是未来高频引力波搜寻的一个理论上动机充分的目标。
classification.one_liner: 研究原初黑洞周围由超辐射形成的引力原子在孤立与双星扰动下产生的高频引力波暂现信号及其可探测性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究黑洞超辐射产生的引力波暂现信号，属于经典引力/广义相对论与引力波物理，直接匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息。

2605.14956v2.title: Gravitational wave propagation through viscous matter
2605.14956v2.abstract: It has been known that gravitational waves (GWs) transfer energy to viscous matter through which they propagate, but the effect is too weak to be astrophysically significant. Using linearized perturbations about a Minkowski background, we previously showed that the interaction can become important when the distance between matter and source is smaller than the GW wavelength. Here, we review extensions to more realistic backgrounds, namely Schwarzschild spacetime and a static spherically symmetric setting. We find that GW damping and the associated heating of the viscous fluid are enhanced, and can lead to substantial attenuation or even gamma-ray bursts. We investigate astrophysical scenarios where these effects may be relevant, including core-collapse supernovae, binary neutron star mergers, and accretion onto binary black hole mergers.

classification.title_zh: 引力波在粘性物质中的传播
classification.abstract_zh: 已知引力波在传播过程中会向粘性物质传递能量，但该效应太弱，在天体物理意义上并不显著。我们此前利用闵可夫斯基背景上的线性化扰动表明，当物质与源之间的距离小于引力波波长时，这种相互作用可能变得重要。这里我们评述向更现实背景的推广，即史瓦西时空和静态球对称情形。我们发现引力波阻尼以及粘性流体的相应加热会被增强，并可能导致显著衰减甚至伽马射线暴。我们考察这些效应可能相关的天体物理场景，包括核坍缩超新星、双中子星并合以及双黑洞并合上的吸积。
classification.one_liner: 把引力波与粘性物质的相互作用推广到史瓦西和静态球对称背景，发现阻尼和加热增强，并讨论超新星、双中子星并合与黑洞吸积等场景。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究广义相对论框架下的引力波传播与经典时空背景效应，直接对应重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；不涉及全息对偶或其他重点支线。

2608.18313v2.title: Curvature-induced phantom mimicry and cosmological bounces without violating the Dominant Energy Condition
2608.18313v2.abstract: We explore the active geometric contribution of spatial curvature in a closed universe, distinguishing between kinematic superacceleration and the strict violation of matter energy conditions. We demonstrate that for pressureless matter obeying the Dominant Energy Condition (DEC), positive spatial curvature does not induce a phantom regime, but leads to a decelerating expansion that culminates in a late-time turnaround ($\dot{H}<0$). At this finite-scale moment, the expansion ceases and the apparent horizon stays regular, signaling the beginning of an eventual Big Crunch. We contrast this behavior with the genuine phantom case ($\omega<-1$), where positive curvature introduces a distinct, early finite-radius expansion bounce ($\dot{H}>0$) that cannot prevent the inevitable late-time Big Rip singularity. Finally, we contextualize these results, discussing how positive spatial curvature can dynamically mimic phantom phenomenology and permit geodesically complete cosmologies without relying on exotic, energy-condition-violating matter.

classification.title_zh: 曲率诱导的幽灵模拟与不违反主导能量条件的宇宙学反弹
classification.abstract_zh: 我们探讨闭合宇宙中空间曲率的主动几何贡献，区分运动学上的超加速与物质能量条件的严格违背。我们证明，对于满足主导能量条件（DEC）的无压物质，正空间曲率不会诱导幽灵区，而是导致减速膨胀，并最终在晚期发生掉头（\dot{H}<0）。在这个有限尺度时刻，膨胀停止，视界保持正则，标志着最终大挤压的开始。我们将此行为与真正的幽灵情形（\omega<-1）进行对比：在后者中，正曲率引入一个独特的、早期有限半径的膨胀反弹（\dot{H}>0），但无法阻止晚期不可避免的大撕裂奇点。最后，我们对这些结果进行语境化讨论，说明正空间曲率如何能够动力学地模拟幽灵现象学，并允许测地完备的宇宙学，而无需依赖违反能量条件的奇异物质。
classification.one_liner: 在闭合宇宙中，正空间曲率可以动力学地模拟幽灵行为并允许测地完备的宇宙演化，而无需违反主导能量条件。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典广义相对论与宇宙学，讨论空间曲率、能量条件和反弹/奇点，不涉及AdS/CFT全息对偶或量子引力全息方法，因此对全息研究直接相关度低；可归入经典引力/广义相对论支线。

2601.07918v3.title: Relativistic jets from millisecond proto-magnetars
2601.07918v3.abstract: Rapidly rotating, strongly magnetized neutron stars (``millisecond proto-magnetars'') formed in stellar core-collapse, neutron star mergers, and white dwarf accretion-induced collapse have long been proposed as central engines of gamma-ray bursts (GRB) and accompanying supernovae/kilonovae. However, during the first few seconds after birth, neutrino heating drives baryon-rich winds from the neutron star surface, potentially limiting the magnetization and achievable Lorentz factors of the outflow and casting doubt on whether proto-magnetars can launch ultra-relativistic jets at early times, as needed to power short-duration GRB. We present 3D general-relativistic magnetohydrodynamic simulations of neutrino-heated proto-magnetar winds that incorporate M0 neutrino transport. While the global wind properties broadly agree with previous analytic estimates calibrated to one-dimensional models, our simulations reveal essential multidimensional effects. For rapidly rotating models with spin periods P = 1 ms, centrifugal forces strongly enhance mass loss near the rotational equator, producing a dense, sub-relativistic outflow ( ~0.1c). This equatorial wind naturally confines and collimates less baryon-loaded outflows emerging from higher latitudes, leading to the formation of a structured bipolar jet with a peak magnetization up to ~ 30-100 along the pole, sufficient to reach bulk Lorentz factors ~ 100 on larger scales. The resulting angular stratification of the outflow energy into ultra-relativistic polar and sub-relativistic equatorial components is broadly consistent with the observed partition between beaming-corrected GRB energies and supernova/kilonova ejecta. Our results demonstrate that millisecond proto-magnetars can launch relativistic jets within seconds of formation and highlight their potential role in powering the diverse electromagnetic counterparts of compact-object explosions.

classification.title_zh: 毫秒原磁星产生的相对论性喷流
classification.abstract_zh: 在恒星核心坍缩、中子星并合以及白矮星吸积诱导坍缩中形成的快速旋转、强磁化中子星（“毫秒原磁星”）长期以来被提出作为伽马射线暴（GRB）及伴随超新星/千新星的中心引擎。然而，在诞生后的最初几秒，中微子加热会从中子星表面驱动重子丰富的风，可能限制外流的磁化程度和可达到的洛伦兹因子，并使人们怀疑原磁星能否在早期发射短伽马暴所需的超相对论喷流。我们提出包含 M0 中微子输运的中微子加热原磁星风的三维广义相对论磁流体力学模拟。虽然整体风性质与先前基于一维模型校准的解析估计大致一致，但我们的模拟揭示了关键的多维效应。对于自转周期 P = 1 ms 的快速旋转模型，离心力强烈增强赤道附近的质量损失，产生稠密的亚相对论外流（约 0.1c）。该赤道风自然地约束和准直来自更高纬度的重子负载较少的外流，导致形成一个结构化双极喷流，极向峰值磁化参数可达约 30-100，足以在更大尺度达到体洛伦兹因子约 100。由此产生的外流能量角向分层为超相对论极向成分和亚相对论赤道成分，与观测到的束流修正后的 GRB 能量与超新星/千新星抛射物之间的分配大致一致。我们的结果表明，毫秒原磁星能够在形成后数秒内发射相对论喷流，并强调它们在驱动致密天体爆炸的多样电磁对应体中的潜在作用。
classification.one_liner: 三维广义相对论磁流体力学模拟表明，毫秒原磁星可通过赤道重子风准直极向喷流，在形成数秒内产生洛伦兹因子约100的相对论外流。
keywords: 广义相对论磁流体力学
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于广义相对论磁流体力学与致密天体喷流研究，与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接相关；不涉及AdS/CFT或其他全息方法。

2602.01319v2.title: Factorized neural posterior estimation for rapid and reliable inference of parameterized post-Einsteinian deviation parameters in gravitational waves
2602.01319v2.abstract: The direct detection of gravitational waves (GWs) by LIGO has confirmed general relativity (GR), but testing GR via GWs requires estimating parameterized post-Einsteinian (ppE) deviation parameters in waveform models. Traditional Bayesian inference methods like Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) provide reliable estimates but suffer from prohibitive computational costs, failing to meet the real-time demands and surging data volume of future GW detectors. Here, we propose a factorized neural posterior estimation framework: we construct independent normalizing flow models for each of the nine ppE deviation parameters, and effectively integrate prior information from other source parameters via a conditional embedding network. Leveraging a hybrid neural network with a convolutional neural network and a Residual Neural Network for feature extraction, our method performs rapid and statistically reliable posterior inference directly from binary black hole signals. Compared to conventional MCMC, our approach achieves millisecond-scale inference time with a speedup factor of $9 \times 10^4$. Comprehensive validations show that the posterior estimates pass the Kolmogorov-Smirnov test and achieve empirical coverage probabilities close to theoretical targets. We apply this method to the GW150914 event and find that the resulting posterior distributions are in good agreement with existing results. This work demonstrates the great potential of deep learning for GW parameter estimation and provides a viable technical solution for real-time GR tests with next-generation detectors.

classification.title_zh: 用于引力波中参数化后爱因斯坦偏差参数快速可靠推断的因子化神经后验估计
classification.abstract_zh: LIGO对引力波的直接探测已证实广义相对论（GR），但通过引力波检验GR需要在波形模型中估计参数化后爱因斯坦（ppE）偏差参数。传统贝叶斯推断方法如马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）能提供可靠估计，但计算成本高得难以承受，无法满足未来引力波探测器的实时需求和数据量激增。在此，我们提出一个因子化神经后验估计框架：为九个ppE偏差参数分别构建独立的归一化流模型，并通过条件嵌入网络有效整合其他源参数的先验信息。利用结合卷积神经网络和残差神经网络的特征提取混合神经网络，我们的方法直接从双黑洞信号执行快速且统计可靠的后验推断。与传统MCMC相比，我们的方法达到毫秒级推断时间，加速因子为9×10^4。综合验证表明，后验估计通过Kolmogorov-Smirnov检验，经验覆盖概率接近理论目标。我们将该方法应用于GW150914事件，发现所得后验分布与已有结果吻合良好。这项工作展示了深度学习在引力波参数估计中的巨大潜力，并为下一代探测器的实时GR检验提供了可行技术方案。
classification.one_liner: 提出因子化神经后验估计框架，从双黑洞引力波信号毫秒级推断ppE偏差参数，以约9×10^4倍加速检验广义相对论。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究引力波参数估计与广义相对论检验，属于经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2606.20787v2.title: Gas-induced gravitational-wave dephasing and accretion periodicities of live post-Newtonian massive black hole binaries: warm disk
2606.20787v2.abstract: We perform 3D hydrodynamical simulations of an equal-mass quasi-circular live $10^6~{\rm M}_\odot$ massive black hole binary (MBHB) embedded in a prograde, locally isothermal circumbinary disk (CBD) with $0.1$ aspect ratio. The binary evolves under the effect of gaseous torques and $2.5$ post-Newtonian dynamics. This approach allows us to track the influence of the CBD on a gravitational-wave (GW) driven MBHB inspiral all the way down to merger from $53$ Schwarzschild radii ($r_s$) over $1.5$ years. Comparing the GW inspiral rate with the viscous inflow, we find the binary to decouple from the CBD just $\approx2$ days before merger. We measure gas torques (gravitational and accretion) with and without concurrent GW emission, finding that their sums agree to within $\lesssim5\%$ down to $25~r_s$. We then measure a gas-induced phase-shift in the GW signal of $\approx9.0\times10^{-4}$ rad that accumulates over a year until $40~r_s$ and saturates afterward, which should be LISA-detectable at redshift $z{\lesssim0.2}$. We further characterize the mass accretion rate modulations. We recover the periodicity associated with the ``lump" at the inner cavity edge. The periodicities at the binary orbital period and at half of it are shifted to lower frequencies. We measure the former, due to relativistic apsidal precession, in an inspiraling binary for the first time, and newly identify the latter as due to the precession of the eccentric cavity. Our results have implications for multi-messenger astronomy, since observation of accretion rate modulation by LSST/Roman surveys and phase-shift by LISA will provide crucial information on the complex environment surrounding MBHBs.

classification.title_zh: 气体诱导的引力波退相位与实时演化后牛顿大质量黑洞双星的吸积周期性：暖盘
classification.abstract_zh: 我们对一个等质量、准圆形、实时演化的 10^6 M_sun 大质量黑洞双星（MBHB）进行了三维流体动力学模拟，该双星嵌入在一个顺行、局部等温、纵横比为 0.1 的环双星盘（CBD）中。双星在气体扭矩和 2.5 后牛顿动力学作用下演化。该方法使我们能够追踪 CBD 对引力波（GW）驱动的 MBHB 旋进的影响，从 53 史瓦西半径（rs）一直跟踪到并合，历时 1.5 年。比较 GW 旋进率与黏性流入，我们发现双星在并合前仅约 2 天与 CBD 退耦。我们测量了有无同时 GW 发射时的气体扭矩（引力扭矩和吸积扭矩），发现它们的总和在直到 25 rs 处符合到 ≲5%。随后我们测得 GW 信号中气体诱导的相位偏移约为 9.0×10^-4 rad，它在一年内累积直到 40 rs，之后饱和；该偏移在红移 z≲0.2 时应该可被 LISA 探测。我们进一步刻画了质量吸积率调制。我们恢复了与内腔边缘“团块”（lump）相关的周期性。双星轨道周期及其一半处的周期性均移至较低频率。我们首次在旋进双星中测量了前者，其由相对论性近星点进动引起，并新识别出后者源于偏心腔的进动。我们的结果对多信使天文学具有重要意义，因为 LSST/Roman 巡天对吸积率调制的观测以及 LISA 对相位偏移的观测，将为 MBHB 周围复杂环境提供关键信息。
classification.one_liner: 三维流体模拟显示，环双星盘气体可在 LISA 可探测范围内使大质量黑洞双星引力波产生退相位，并产生与轨道及偏心腔进动相关的吸积率周期性。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究后牛顿大质量黑洞双星、引力波退相位与环双星盘吸积，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息，但与重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”直接匹配。

2606.25702v3.title: DANTE: A Reference-Guided Unsupervised Pipeline for Extended-Transient Anomaly Characterization in LIGO O4a
2606.25702v3.abstract: The analysis of gravitational-wave detector data during the fourth observing run (O4) requires robust methods to distinguish stationary instrumental noise from non-stationary transients (glitches). In this work, we present DANTE (Domain-Adaptive Network for Transient Evaluation), a pipeline designed to discover and triage novel non-stationary artifacts entirely without labels. We demonstrate that adapting a pre-trained Vision Transformer (DINOv2) to extract local patch embeddings from time-frequency spectrograms allows for high-resolution mapping of transient anomalies. We formalize the Signal Dilution Barrier via controlled injection tests, showing that while Multiple Instance Learning (MIL) Top-k pooling recovers extended topologies, it is blind to sub-second morphologies. To address small-sample taxonomy instability, we introduce an adaptive Dirichlet Process Mixture Model (DPMM) that dynamically selects covariance structures. Finally, by implementing a native O4a background recalibration, we resolve the domain-shift problem, demonstrating consistency with the hypothesis that pervasive O4a morphologies (initially flagged as novel by historical references) are stationary artifacts. We conclude that unsupervised anomaly detection strictly requires native recalibration to filter domain-shift artifacts, while definitive classification of remaining unmodeled singletons requires multi-channel validation.

classification.title_zh: DANTE：用于 LIGO O4a 扩展瞬态异常表征的参考引导无监督流程
classification.abstract_zh: 对第四次观测运行（O4）期间引力波探测器数据的分析，需要稳健方法来区分平稳仪器噪声与非平稳瞬态（glitch）。本文提出 DANTE（Domain-Adaptive Network for Transient Evaluation），一种完全无需标签即可发现并分诊新型非平稳伪影的流程。我们证明，将预训练 Vision Transformer（DINOv2）适配为从时频谱图中提取局部 patch 嵌入，可实现瞬态异常的高分辨率映射。我们通过受控注入测试形式化“信号稀释屏障”，表明 Multiple Instance Learning（MIL）Top-k 池化虽能恢复扩展拓扑，但对亚秒形态不敏感。为解决小样本分类不稳定问题，我们引入自适应 Dirichlet Process Mixture Model（DPMM），动态选择协方差结构。最后，通过实现原生 O4a 背景重校准，我们解决域偏移问题，证明与以下假设一致：普遍存在的 O4a 形态（最初被历史参考标记为新颖）是平稳伪影。我们总结，无监督异常检测严格要求原生重校准以过滤域偏移伪影，而对剩余未建模单例的最终分类需要多通道验证。
classification.one_liner: DANTE 用无监督视觉嵌入与自适应 DPMM 在 LIGO O4a 中表征扩展瞬态异常，并强调原生重校准以消除域偏移。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文是 LIGO O4a 引力波探测器数据中 glitch/异常的无监督表征，属于经典引力/引力波实验数据分析；与全息对偶、量子引力或纠缠/复杂度等理论主题无关。

2607.05331v2.title: Modeling Uncertainties in Modified Gravity Predictions for the Stochastic Gravitational-Wave Background
2607.05331v2.abstract: We investigate the impact of modified gravity on the stochastic gravitational-wave background (SGWB) generated by a cosmological population of unresolved binary black hole mergers. We consider two complementary classes of beyond-General Relativity (GR) effects: waveform-generation modifications described within the parametrized post-Einsteinian (ppE) framework and cosmological propagation effects associated with a modified gravitational-wave luminosity distance. Astrophysical uncertainties in the binary black hole population are consistently incorporated using a Power-Law plus Peak mass model combined with a Madau--Dickinson merger-rate evolution. Using SGWB forecasts for Advanced LIGO, the Einstein Telescope (ET), and Cosmic Explorer (CE), we perform injection-recovery analyses jointly varying modified-gravity and astrophysical population parameters. We show that frequency-dependent ppE corrections produce characteristic distortions in the SGWB spectral shape and can be meaningfully constrained by third-generation detectors, particularly CE. In contrast, modified propagation effects mainly induce smooth amplitude rescalings and exhibit stronger degeneracies with astrophysical uncertainties. Our results demonstrate that future SGWB observations will provide a complementary probe of gravitational physics across cosmic history and may open new avenues for testing deviations from GR beyond individually resolved compact-binary events.

classification.title_zh: 建模修改引力对随机引力波背景预测中的不确定性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究修改引力对由宇宙学尺度上未分辨双黑洞并合族群产生的随机引力波背景（SGWB）的影响。我们考虑两类互补的超越广义相对论（GR）效应：用参数化后爱因斯坦（ppE）框架描述的波形产生修改，以及与修改的引力波光度距离相关的宇宙学传播效应。双黑洞族群的天体物理不确定性通过幂律加峰值质量模型并结合 Madau-Dickinson 并合率演化被一致地纳入。利用 Advanced LIGO、Einstein Telescope（ET）和 Cosmic Explorer（CE）的 SGWB 预测，我们进行注入-恢复分析，联合变化修改引力与天体物理族群参数。我们表明，频率依赖的 ppE 修正会在 SGWB 谱形中产生特征性畸变，并能被第三代探测器、尤其是 CE 有意义地限制。相比之下，修改传播效应主要导致平滑的振幅重标定，并与天体物理不确定性有更强的简并。我们的结果表明，未来 SGWB 观测将为跨越宇宙历史的引力物理提供互补探针，并可能开辟超越已分辨致密双星事件来检验偏离 GR 的新途径。
classification.one_liner: 该文对未来引力波探测器下修改引力产生的随机引力波背景谱进行建模，并分析其与双黑洞族群天体物理不确定性的简并。
keywords: 参数化后爱因斯坦框架
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究引力波背景与修改引力预测，属于经典引力/广义相对论支线；不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2609.39720v1.title: Hadronic light-by-light scattering in AdS/QCD and the muon $g-2$: tensor meson contributions
2609.39720v1.abstract: We briefly review the predictions of holographic QCD in hard-wall AdS/QCD models for the contribution of pseudoscalars and axial-vector mesons to the hadronic light-by-light amplitude and consequently to the muon anomalous magnetic moment, which allows one to satisfy the Melnikov-Vainshtein constraint in a purely hadronic model. Moreover, we discuss the role of tensor mesons in satisfying the remaining short-distance constraints, and provide details for a minimal model of tensor mesons that turns out to agree remarkably well with available data from BELLE as well as preliminary low-$Q^2$ data from BESIII. In an appendix, we also provide analytical results for the short-distance limits in hQCD and compare with the leading-order OPE result as given by the massless quark loop.

classification.title_zh: AdS/QCD 中的强子光对光散射与 μ子 g-2：张量介子贡献
classification.abstract_zh: 我们简要回顾硬墙 AdS/QCD 模型对赝标量介子和轴矢介子贡献强子光对光振幅、进而对 μ子反常磁矩的预言，这使得可以在纯强子模型中满足 Melnikov-Vainshtein 约束。此外，我们讨论张量介子在满足剩余短距离约束中的作用，并给出一个最小张量介子模型的细节；该模型与 BELLE 的现有数据以及 BESIII 的初步低 Q^2 数据吻合得非常好。在附录中，我们还给出 hQCD 中短距离极限的解析结果，并与无质量夸克圈给出的领头阶 OPE 结果进行比较。
classification.one_liner: 在硬墙 AdS/QCD 中讨论赝标量、轴矢及张量介子对强子光对光散射和 μ子 g-2 的贡献，并用张量介子满足短距离约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD 应用，研究 AdS/QCD 中强子光对光散射与 μ子 g-2，包含张量介子贡献；这落在全息 QCD/核物理主题内，但与用户列出的重点支线（全息超流超导、相变与气泡成核、QNM 与非线性演化、经典引力等）没有直接对应。

2602.01343v2.title: Heavy-particle production during inflation and its gravitational-wave signal
2602.01343v2.abstract: We study a mechanism for producing heavy particles during inflation through a transient quadratic $U(1)$-breaking interaction of a complex scalar coupled derivatively to the inflaton. The rolling inflaton induces an effective chemical potential, while sufficiently strong symmetry breaking creates a tachyonic instability that amplifies the scalar fluctuations. The finite duration of the instability limits their growth, allowing efficient production of particles heavier than the Hubble scale in regimes where homogeneous backreaction remains small. The amplified fluctuations source a peaked gravitational-wave spectrum through their anisotropic stress. We calculate this spectrum by following the full time evolution of the source. For suitable parameters and production times, our idealized forecasts suggest that the signal could be observable with LISA, subject to the assumed switching profile and reheating history.

classification.title_zh: 暴胀期间重粒子产生及其引力波信号
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究一种在暴胀期间产生重粒子的机制：通过一个与暴胀子导数耦合的复标量的瞬时二次 U(1) 破缺相互作用来实现。滚动的暴胀子诱导出有效化学势，而足够强的对称性破缺产生快子不稳定性，从而放大标量涨落。不稳定性的有限持续时间限制其增长，使得在同质反作用仍然较小的区域中，可以高效产生质量超过哈勃尺度的粒子。被放大的涨落通过其各向异性应力产生一个峰状引力波谱。我们通过追踪源的全时演化来计算该谱。对于合适的参数和产生时间，我们的理想化预测表明，在给定的切换轮廓和再加热历史假设下，该信号可能可被 LISA 观测到。
classification.one_liner: 暴胀中通过瞬时 U(1) 破缺和快子不稳定性产生超哈勃重粒子，其涨落各向异性应力给出可能被 LISA 观测的峰状引力波谱。
classification.relevance_reason: 该论文属于暴胀宇宙学与引力波现象，可关联到经典引力/引力波支线，但与 AdS/CFT、全息强关联、纠缠等用户全息重点方向无直接关系。

2610.00468v1.title: ${\mathcal{N}}=3$ supersymmetric AdS$_4$ solutions in $d=11$ supergravity
2610.00468v1.abstract: We derive the necessary and sufficient conditions for AdS$_4$ solutions of $d=11$ supergravity to preserve ${\mathcal{N}} \leq 3$ supersymmetry. We use our setup to first impose ${\mathcal{N}}=2$ supersymmetry, recovering a previously known class of solutions, providing a non-trivial consistency of our equations. We then focus on the ${\mathcal{N}} = 3 $ case, first deriving the Tri-Sasaki class and then proving its uniqueness as the only ${\mathcal{N}} = 3$ AdS$_4$ class in eleven dimensional supergravity. Our work proves that all supersymmetric AdS$_4$ solutions preserving ${\mathcal{N}} > 2 $ supersymmetry are necessarily of Tri-Sasaki type.

classification.title_zh: d=11 超引力中的 N=3 超对称 AdS4 解
classification.abstract_zh: 我们推导了 d=11 超引力中 AdS4 解保持 N≤3 超对称的充分必要条件。我们利用该框架先施加 N=2 超对称，复原了一类先前已知的解，从而验证了方程的非平庸自洽性。随后我们聚焦 N=3 情形，先推导出 Tri-Sasaki 类，然后证明其唯一性：它是十一维超引力中唯一的 N=3 AdS4 类。我们的工作证明，所有保持 N>2 超对称的超对称 AdS4 解必然属于 Tri-Sasaki 型。
classification.one_liner: 给出 d=11 超引力中 N≤3 超对称 AdS4 解的充要条件，并证明 N=3 解唯一为 Tri-Sasaki 型。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 AdS/CFT 与超引力解分类的基础方向，但未涉及用户重点的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM 与非线性演化、冷原子等具体支线。

2610.00478v1.title: Algebraic structure in holographic tensor networks
2610.00478v1.abstract: In a previous work 2511.21852, we explored the hypothesis that in general theories of quantum gravity, spacetime regions known as generalized entanglement wedges (introduced by Bousso and Penington) have an associated subalgebra of observables in a semiclassical limit. We defined an entropy associated with these subalgebras that obeys the same monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties as the generalized gravitational entropy of generalized entanglement wedges. Here, we test aspects of these ideas making use of tensor network toy models for holography. In this context, the analog of a generalized entanglement wedge is a region for which no region containing it has a smaller number of boundary legs. In the limit of large bond dimension (analogous to the semiclassical limit), we argue that each such region has a canonically associated subalgebra of the full algebra of observables on the boundary Hilbert space, as well as a family of unitarily related von Neumann factor subalgebras. We investigate in detail how various algebraic operations on these subalgebras (e.g. their intersections, joins, and commutants) are related to corresponding geometrical operations on the tensor network regions. We study to what extent the monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties of generalized entropy for generalized entanglement wedges follow from properties of our algebraic entropy. We also introduce an alternative entropic quantity $S(\omega || \omega \circ E_{\mathcal{A}'})$ associated with a subalgebra $\mathcal{A}$ that also obeys monotonicity and strong subadditivity properties with suitable conditions. Finally, we explain how to define a type $II_1$ von Neumann algebra based on an infinite family of random tensor networks with increasing bond dimension such that the regions corresponding to generalized entanglement wedges can be associated with exact subalgebras of this full algebra.

classification.title_zh: 全息张量网络中的代数结构
classification.abstract_zh: 在先前工作 2511.21852 中，我们探讨了一个假设：在一般量子引力理论中，所谓广义纠缠楔（由 Bousso 和 Penington 引入）在半经典极限下具有相关联的可观测量子代数。我们定义了与这些子代数相关的熵，它满足与广义纠缠楔的广义引力熵相同的单调性和强次可加性。本文利用全息张量网络玩具模型检验这些想法。在此背景下，广义纠缠楔的类比是这样一个区域：不存在包含它且边界腿数更少的区域。在大键维极限（类比半经典极限）下，我们论证每个这样的区域都典范地关联于边界希尔伯特空间全可观测量代数的一个子代数，以及一族通过酉变换相联系的 von Neumann 因子子代数。我们详细研究这些子代数上的各种代数运算（如交、并、交换子）如何与张量网络区域上的相应几何运算相联系。我们研究广义纠缠楔广义熵的单调性和强次可加性在多大程度上可由我们代数熵的性质推出。我们还引入与子代数 A 相关的另一熵量 S(ω || ω ∘ E_{A'})，它在适当条件下也满足单调性和强次可加性。最后，我们说明如何基于键维不断增大的无限随机张量网络族定义 type II_1 von Neumann 代数，使得对应广义纠缠楔的区域可与该全代数的精确子代数相关联。
classification.one_liner: 用全息张量网络检验广义纠缠楔的子代数结构，并定义相关代数熵与 type II_1 von Neumann 代数。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息张量网络与代数量子信息基础，未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、探针膜与 Floquet 驱动、QNM、相变气泡成核或经典引力等具体支线。

2610.00482v1.title: Twisted BPS decoupling limits and AdS/CFT
2610.00482v1.abstract: BPS decoupling limits of string and M-theory have led to profound insights into gravity and non-perturbative quantum theory, most notably with the AdS/CFT correspondence. In this paper, we initiate the study of twisted BPS decoupling limits, in which the relevant BPS states carry momentum along circle fibers geometrically twisted over a base space. Prime examples are found in type IIB string theory on AdS$_5\times S^5$, for which the twisted limits involve the BPS states of the global symmetry algebra PSU$(2,2|4)$. In general, string fluctuations in a twisted BPS decoupling limit are described by non-relativistic sigma-models on emergent non-Lorentzian target spaces with a natural symplectic structure. This further supports the broader connection between BPS limits and non-Lorentzian geometry. We introduce analogous limits of D-branes as well, probing the same symplectic structure as the string. For AdS$_5\times S^5$, twisted BPS decoupling limits are dual to Spin Matrix theory limits of $\mathcal{N}=4$ supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory, providing tractable and explicit quantum-mechanical descriptions of non-perturbative regimes of AdS/CFT.

classification.title_zh: 扭曲 BPS 解耦极限与 AdS/CFT
classification.abstract_zh: 弦论和 M 理论的 BPS 解耦极限为引力和非微扰量子理论带来了深刻洞见，最显著的是 AdS/CFT 对应。本文启动对扭曲 BPS 解耦极限的研究，其中相关 BPS 态携带沿几何上扭曲于底空间之上的圆纤维的动量。典型例子出现在 AdS5×S5 上的 IIB 型弦论，其扭曲极限涉及整体对称代数 PSU(2,2|4) 的 BPS 态。一般而言，扭曲 BPS 解耦极限中的弦涨落由涌现的非洛伦兹靶空间上的非相对论 sigma 模型描述，该靶空间具有自然的辛结构。这进一步支持 BPS 极限与非洛伦兹几何之间的更广泛联系。我们还引入 D-膜的类似极限，它们探测与弦相同的辛结构。对于 AdS5×S5，扭曲 BPS 解耦极限对偶于 N=4 超对称 Yang-Mills 理论的 Spin Matrix 理论极限，为 AdS/CFT 的非微扰区域提供了可处理且显式的量子力学描述。
classification.one_liner: 本文提出扭曲 BPS 解耦极限，将 AdS5×S5 弦论的非洛伦兹辛几何与 N=4 SYM 的 Spin Matrix 极限对偶起来。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接属于 AdS/CFT 基础与非相对论/非洛伦兹极限，涉及 D-膜和 Spin Matrix 理论；但不匹配用户重点标签中的全息凝聚态、探针膜、QNM、经典引力等具体支线，故为中等相关。

2610.00556v1.title: Hamiltonian formalism for a 5-D brane cosmolgy
2610.00556v1.abstract: In this work we explores the dynamic solutions of a brane system in a five dimensional space-time under the Hamiltonian perspective, using the De Donner Weyl formalism. We obtain the dynamic equations for the scale factors, and obtain the Friedmann-like equations in general way. We present the solutions of the scale factors as a function of the extra coordinate, $y$, we show that the geometry is related to the matter-energy component in the brane. Finally, we develop the ADM formalism in the brane point of view with the foliation of the 3-dimensional space which is embedded in a 5-dimensional manifold.

classification.title_zh: 五维膜宇宙学的哈密顿形式
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在哈密顿视角下，利用 De Donner Weyl 形式研究五维时空中的膜系统动力学解。我们得到标度因子的动力学方程，并以一般方式导出类 Friedmann 方程。我们给出标度因子作为额外坐标 y 的函数的解，并表明几何与膜上的物质-能量组分相关。最后，我们在膜的观点下发展 ADM 形式，对嵌入五维流形的三维空间进行叶状分层。
classification.one_liner: 用 De Donner Weyl 与 ADM 形式分析五维膜宇宙学的标度因子动力学和类 Friedmann 方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/膜世界方向，涉及哈密顿与ADM形式；但摘要未涉及全息对偶或用户列出的全息重点支线。

2610.00670v1.title: Monogamous quantum corrections to holographic mutual information
2610.00670v1.abstract: We construct an extensive model of bulk mutual information (MI) in anti-de Sitter spacetime and use it to describe the leading quantum corrections to the MI of certain holographic theories. The equivalence between bulk and boundary MI follows from the Faulkner--Lewkowycz--Maldacena prescription. We show that the extensivity of the bulk MI is sufficient for the quantum-corrected boundary entropy vector to satisfy monogamy of MI and all other holographic entropy cone inequalities. Our model is built from a covariantly conserved current-current kernel in AdS and is realized explicitly by a free massive Dirac fermion, whose boundary MI at long distances is that of a fermionic generalized free field (GFF). The construction also reproduces the expected short-distance divergence structure of a GFF, and the current-current correlator defines a positive and monotonically decreasing function along the renormalization-group flow. We illustrate this explicitly for disjoint half-disks at the conformal fixed point of the model in AdS$_3$, where we present the exact result.

classification.title_zh: 全息互信息的单配性量子修正
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了反 de Sitter 时空中体互信息（MI）的一个广延模型，并用它描述某些全息理论中 MI 的首个量子修正。体与边界 MI 的等价性来自 Faulkner--Lewkowycz--Maldacena 方案。我们表明，体 MI 的广延性足以使量子修正后的边界熵矢量满足 MI 的单配性以及所有其他全息熵锥不等式。我们的模型由 AdS 中协变守恒的流-流核构成，并由一个自由大质量 Dirac 费米子显式实现；其边界 MI 在长距离下为费米子广义自由场（GFF）的 MI。该构造也重现了 GFF 预期的短距离发散结构，并且流-流关联函数沿重整化群流定义了一个正且单调递减的函数。我们在 AdS3 中模型的共形不动点处，对不相交半圆盘显式说明了这一点，并给出精确结果。
classification.one_liner: 通过 AdS 中协变守恒的流-流核构造体互信息的广延模型，证明量子修正后的边界熵矢量满足互信息单配性与全息熵锥不等式。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究全息互信息的量子修正与全息熵锥不等式，属于全息量子信息方向；但与用户列出的全息超流、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋、multi-trace、QNM、冷原子、D3-D7、经典引力等重点支线无直接重合。

2610.00844v1.title: Complexity study of the Hartle-Hawking state in JT gravity
2610.00844v1.abstract: The negativity of the Wigner function gives an operationally meaningful measure of the complexity of simulating a quantum state on a classical computer. We study its growth for the Hartle-Hawking state under time evolution in Jackiw-Teitelboim gravity, in the length basis. At the disk level, and to leading order in the semiclassical parameter $\beta$, the Hartle-Hawking state is a minimum-uncertainty Gaussian wavepacket at rest at the turning point of the Liouville wall, centred at $x=2\log(2\beta/\pi)$ with $\langle p^2\rangle=\pi^2/8\beta$. Its Wigner function is positive, so its negativity is $1+o(1)$ for all sub-exponential times; it is even in $t$ by time-reversal symmetry, and exactly frozen once the reflected packet decouples from the wall, because free evolution is a Clifford shear. At late times the negativity saturates close to its upper bound, at $\sqrt{2/\pi}\sqrt{d_{\rm eff}(\beta)}$ with $d_{\rm eff}(\beta)=Z(\beta)^2/Z(2\beta)$, a value that requires the discrete spectrum. Unlike the spectral form factor, the negativity displays no ramp: the two-boundary wormhole contribution is suppressed by $e^{-2S_0}$ relative to a disk term that, unlike that of the spectral form factor, does not decay. The exact survival amplitude $Z(\beta+it)/Z(\beta)$ gives the spread complexity growing as $\sigma_E^2t^2$, and the seed-normalised negativity is, at the disk level, the inverse of the exact survival probability. We take this as evidence that the length basis is ideally suited for a dual, semi-classical effective description of chaotic quantum dynamics for large $e^{S_0}$ at sub-exponential times.

classification.title_zh: JT 引力中 Hartle-Hawking 态的复杂度研究
classification.abstract_zh: Wigner 函数的负性给出一种操作上有意义的度量，用于衡量在经典计算机上模拟一个量子态的复杂度。我们在长度基下研究 Jackiw-Teitelboim 引力中 Hartle-Hawking 态随时间演化的这种负性增长。在圆盘层面，并在半经典参数 β 的领头阶，Hartle-Hawking 态是一个最小不确定度高斯波包，静止于 Liouville 墙的转折点，中心在 x=2log(2β/π)，且 ⟨p^2⟩=π^2/8β。其 Wigner 函数为正，因此对于所有亚指数时间，其负性为 1+o(1)；由时间反演对称性它关于 t 为偶，并且一旦反射波包从墙上解耦，它就完全冻结，因为自由演化是一个 Clifford 剪切。在晚期，负性饱和到接近其上界 sqrt(2/π) sqrt(d_eff(β))，其中 d_eff(β)=Z(β)^2/Z(2β)，该值需要离散谱。与谱形状因子不同，负性没有 ramp：相对于一个不衰减的圆盘项（不同于谱形状因子中的圆盘项），双边界虫洞贡献被 e^{-2S_0} 压低。精确存活振幅 Z(β+it)/Z(β) 给出的 spread complexity 按 σ_E^2 t^2 增长，而种子归一化的负性在圆盘层面是精确存活概率的倒数。我们认为这表明长度基非常适合在大 e^{S_0}、亚指数时间下为混沌量子动力学提供对偶的半经典有效描述。
classification.one_liner: 在 JT 引力的长度基中，Hartle-Hawking 态的 Wigner 负性在亚指数时间受冻结、晚期饱和，显示该基适合描述混沌量子动力学的半经典对偶。
classification.relevance_reason: 主要属于 JT/AdS2 与量子复杂度；未涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波多分量、畴壁/孤子、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子、D3-D7/Floquet 或经典引力支线。

2610.01152v1.title: The Love for Three Logarithms: Universal Running of Dynamical Love Numbers
2610.01152v1.abstract: The static tidal Love numbers of black holes vanish in general relativity (GR), but are generically non-zero, and in fact 'run' logarithmically with scale, in more general theories or beyond the static limit. We expose a model-agnostic framework for the running of Love numbers at the dynamical level, valid for any tidal perturbation on any static, spherically symmetric, asymptotically flat background, based on the near-zone expansion in powers of the frequency $\omega$ and on the monodromy at spatial infinity. A master recurrence formula determines the monodromy generator to all orders in $\omega^2$, whose three independent entries fully encode the running of the Love numbers. This structure explains the quadratic nature of the renormalization group equation, here proved to all orders and for any type of Love number. We discuss the scheme dependence of the logarithmic coefficients, which is made transparent by the monodromy form. In particular, this clarifies that the anomalous exponents of the tidal field, the so-called 'renormalized angular momentum' of the Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi formalism, are scheme-invariant and directly computable on any spacetime, without need of explicit solutions. We discuss several applications to black holes, including the derivation of a closed-form formula for the leading dynamical running of axial Love numbers of Reissner-Nordstr\"om black holes, proving in particular that it vanishes in the extremal limit. For generic black holes beyond GR, we prove that dynamical running probes deformations of the metric at lower multipoles than the static one, and we illustrate the power of the method by deriving some exact results for the Hayward and Bardeen regular black holes.

classification.title_zh: 三对数的爱：动力学 Love 数的普适跑动
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论（GR）中，黑洞的静态潮汐 Love 数消失，但在更一般的理论中或超出静态极限时，它们通常非零，并会随尺度对数“跑动”。我们提出一个模型无关的框架，用于动力学层次 Love 数的跑动，适用于任何静态、球对称、渐近平坦背景上的任意潮汐扰动，其基础是频率 ω 的近区展开以及空间无穷远处的单值性。一个主递推公式可将单值性生成元确定到 ω² 的所有阶，其三个独立矩阵元完全编码 Love 数的跑动。该结构解释了重整化群方程的二次性质，并在此对所有阶和任意类型 Love 数给出证明。我们讨论对数系数的方案依赖性，单值性形式使之透明。特别地，这阐明了潮汐场的反常指数，即 Mano-Suzuki-Takasugi 形式中的所谓“重整化角动量”，是方案不变的，并可直接在任何时空上计算，无需显式解。我们讨论若干黑洞应用，包括推导 Reissner-Nordström 黑洞轴向 Love 数领头动力学跑动的闭式公式，并证明其在极端极限下消失。对于 GR 之外的普遍黑洞，我们证明动力学跑动探测的是比静态情形更低多极数的度规形变，并通过推导 Hayward 和 Bardeen 正则黑洞的一些精确结果来说明该方法的威力。
classification.one_liner: 提出模型无关的单值性框架，证明动力学 Love 数的对数跑动由二次重整化群方程支配，并给出多种黑洞的精确应用。
classification.relevance_reason: 摘要完全属于经典引力/广义相对论支线：研究黑洞潮汐 Love 数、动力学扰动与对数跑动，不涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶；与用户的“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签直接匹配。

2610.01366v1.title: A celestial viewpoint on infrared divergences in QCD
2610.01366v1.abstract: Non-abelian infrared radiation can be seen as both a practical ingredient for QCD phenomenology and a window on the long-distance structure of gauge theories. During the last decade, a novel viewpoint was developed on infrared phenomena: soft currents are seen as arising from asymptotic symmetries realised on the celestial sphere, and soft colour correlations similarly emerge from a two-dimensional conformal field theory on the sphere. In this contribution, we briefly review the status of this approach. We begin with the standard bulk picture, presenting the infrared factorisation of massless scattering amplitudes, and then we show how universal infrared information gets mapped to marked points on the celestial sphere. In particular, soft colour-dipole singularities are reproduced to all orders by a correlator of vertex operators in a free-boson theory on the sphere. We then proceed to study soft-gluon currents, and show how bulk results constrain the structure of the celestial theory beyond the free-field limit. For single emission, we note that all logarithms in dipole-like loop contributions can be absorbed into the choice of scale for the strong coupling. For multiple emission, we show how the emerging mixed-helicity celestial operator product expansion must be weighted by energy fractions, breaking holomorphic factorisation and obstructing associativity under successive collinear limits. These results illustrate a remarkable connection between the familiar physics of infrared QCD and the dynamics of a two-dimensional theory on the celestial sphere.

classification.title_zh: QCD 红外发散的天球视角
classification.abstract_zh: 非阿贝尔红外辐射既可以看作 QCD 唯象学的实用要素，也可以看作理解规范理论长程结构的窗口。过去十年中，人们发展出关于红外现象的一种新视角：软流被看作由天球上实现的渐近对称性产生，而软色关联类似地由天球上的二维共形场论涌现。本文简要回顾这一方法的现状。我们先从标准的体时空图像出发，给出无质量散射振幅的红外因子化，然后展示普适的红外信息如何被映射到天球上的标记点。特别地，软色偶极奇点可以由天球上自由玻色子理论中顶点算符的关联函数以所有阶重现。随后我们研究软胶子流，并展示体时空结果如何约束超越自由场极限的天球理论结构。对于单次发射，我们注意到偶极型圈贡献中的所有对数都可以被吸收到强耦合尺度的选择中。对于多次发射，我们展示新出现的混合螺旋度天球算符乘积展开必须按能量分数加权，从而破坏全纯因子化，并阻碍连续共线极限下的结合性。这些结果说明了熟悉的红外 QCD 物理与天球上二维理论动力学之间的显著联系。
classification.one_liner: 综述并拓展 QCD 红外现象的天球视角：软流与软色关联对应天球二维 CFT，软胶子流与 OPE 结构揭示超越自由场极限的新约束。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于天球全息/QCD 红外发散方向，与用户列出的重点标签（全息超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动、经典引力/广义相对论）均无直接对应。

2610.01455v1.title: From Modal Memory to Topological Relaxation in a Driven Holographic Superfluid
2610.01455v1.abstract: We study how driving history affects the nonlinear topological relaxation of a holographic superfluid. Different histories are constructed to reach the same present driving conditions and then follow the same future protocol. Although they relax to the same final winding sector, their late-time dynamics remain strongly history-dependent: the residence time of the penultimate winding sector changes by about a factor of \(3.7\). This variation is organised by the modal imbalance carried into the common amplification stage. Histories with different shapes but matched modal imbalance produce nearly identical relaxation times. The same qualitative behaviour is found for a second pair of competing modes.

classification.primary_topic: 全息凝聚态/超流超导/强关联
secondary_topics: 非均匀态/孤子/涡旋/畴壁
classification.title_zh: 驱动全息超流体中从模态记忆到拓扑弛豫
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究驱动历史如何影响全息超流体的非线性拓扑弛豫。构造不同历史以达到相同的当前驱动条件，然后遵循相同的未来协议。尽管它们弛豫到相同的最终缠绕扇区，其晚期动力学仍强烈依赖历史：倒数第二个缠绕扇区的停留时间变化约 3.7 倍。这种变化由进入共同放大阶段的模态不平衡所组织。形状不同但模态不平衡匹配的历史产生几乎相同的弛豫时间。对于第二对竞争模式也发现相同的定性行为。
classification.one_liner: 驱动全息超流体的拓扑弛豫具有历史依赖性，共同的模态不平衡决定晚期弛豫时间。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究驱动全息超流体的非线性拓扑弛豫，涉及缠绕扇区、竞争模式和模态记忆，贴合全息超流超导、拓扑缺陷/非均匀态及非线性演化支线。

2610.01665v1.title: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet quintessential inflation: From super-inflation to emergent warm inflation
2610.01665v1.abstract: This work presents a unified inflationary and late-time cosmology, developed within Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity coupled to three scalar fields, governed by a single potential and coupling function throughout cosmic history. Permitting the Gauss-Bonnet coupling to depend on the field content, rather than assigning it arbitrarily, produces a two-phase inflationary scenario: the higher-curvature term initially drives expansion and later becomes a subdominant. The initial super-inflationary stage ends dynamically when the geometrically induced stabilization of the waterfall field fails, at a field value determined by the combination $(n-1)Q$. Coherent oscillations of the waterfall condensate serve as the initial radiation source, replacing conventional reheating and establishing the thermal bath necessary for the subsequent warm phase. Utilizing a two-stage dissipation mechanism with $\Gamma_\phi\propto T^3$, the scalar and tensor spectra are derived while retaining Gauss-Bonnet contributions, demonstrating that the growth of inflaton fluctuations is regulated by the shear viscosity of the bath, which is essential for model viability. A quartic potential, previously excluded in the cold scenario, becomes viable, with $n_s$ within the Planck $1\sigma$ band and $r$ suppressed. Agreement with the spectral index is generic, while internal consistency confines the model to a narrow band in $(n-1)Q$. Finally, the release of the third scalar near matter-radiation equality transforms a very small mass scale into a very large coupling by a logic inverse to the seesaw mechanism. At late times, the inflaton persists as dark energy.

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 精质暴胀：从超暴胀到涌现温暴胀
classification.abstract_zh: 本工作提出一个统一的暴胀与晚期宇宙学模型，它在与三个标量场耦合的 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中构建，并由贯穿宇宙历史的单一势函数和耦合函数支配。允许 Gauss-Bonnet 耦合依赖于场内容，而非任意指定，会产生一个两阶段暴胀情景：更高曲率项最初驱动膨胀，随后变为次主导。初始超暴胀阶段在瀑布场由几何诱导的稳定化失效时动态结束，对应的场值由组合 $(n-1)Q$ 决定。瀑布凝聚体的相干振荡充当初始辐射源，取代传统重加热，并建立后续温相所需的热浴。利用满足 $\Gamma_\phi\propto T^3$ 的两阶段耗散机制，在保留 Gauss-Bonnet 贡献的情况下推导了标量和张量谱，表明暴胀子涨落的增长受热浴剪切黏度调节，这对模型可行性至关重要。此前在冷暴胀情景中被排除的四次势变得可行，$n_s$ 落在 Planck $1\sigma$ 区间内且 $r$ 被压低。与谱指数的符合是普遍的，而内部一致性将模型限制在 $(n-1)Q$ 的窄带内。最后，第三个标量场在物质-辐射相等附近释放，以与跷跷板机制相反的逻辑将很小的质量标度转化为很大的耦合。在晚期，暴胀子持续作为暗能量。
classification.one_liner: 在 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 引力中，用三个标量场和单一势/耦合函数构建从超暴胀、温暴胀到暗能量的统一宇宙学模型。
classification.relevance_reason: 主题为 Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet 修改引力宇宙学与温暴胀，属于经典引力/宇宙学范畴；不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子信息。

2610.01790v1.title: DSSYK, open ASEP/TASEP and 2d dilaton gravity at strong coupling
2610.01790v1.abstract: We discuss the triality between stochastic growth models in the KPZ universality class, the DSSYK model, and low dimensional dilaton gravity. The TASEP model, which will be our primary focus, is identified with the strong-coupling limit of two-dimensional quantum gravity. The Hamiltonian of DSSYK and the transfer matrix of ASEP coincide up to an additive constant, and we derive the exact expression for the resolvent of the corresponding transfer matrix in ASEP on a finite interval. We also mention the relation of cumulants with the Tutte polynomial $T(1,q)$ of the crossing graph dual to the chord diagram, which implies the relationship of the models considered with the $Q=0$ Potts model coupled with gravity. We further exploit the realization of all these models in terms of different versions of discrete and continuous random walks on two-dimensional manifolds, which parameterize the Hilbert spaces of the respective theories. The representation of TASEP as the growth model of heaps provides new insight into strong-coupling gravity, suggesting its interpretation as an emerging phenomenon. The new dualities between ASEP and q-TASEP models and heap models providing a useful growth interpretation have been developed.

classification.title_zh: DSSYK、开放 ASEP/TASEP 与强耦合下的二维膨胀引力
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了 KPZ 普适类中的随机生长模型、DSSYK 模型与低维膨胀引力之间的三元对偶。TASEP 模型（我们将主要关注的对象）被等同于二维量子引力的强耦合极限。DSSYK 的哈密顿量与 ASEP 的转移矩阵在相差一个加性常数时一致，我们推导了有限区间上 ASEP 相应转移矩阵预解式的精确表达式。我们还提到累积量与交叉图（对偶于弦图）的 Tutte 多项式 T(1,q) 的关系，这意味着所考虑的模型与耦合引力的 Q=0 Potts 模型有关。我们进一步利用这些模型在二维流形上不同版本离散和连续随机游走的实现，这些流形参数化了相应理论的希尔伯特空间。将 TASEP 表示为堆的生长模型为强耦合引力提供了新洞见，暗示其可被解释为一种涌现现象。ASEP 与 q-TASEP 模型以及提供有用生长解释的堆模型之间的新对偶性得到了发展。
classification.one_liner: 建立 DSSYK、开放 ASEP/TASEP 与二维膨胀引力之间的三元对偶，并给出 ASEP 转移矩阵预解式及堆模型解释。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于 DSSYK/低维膨胀引力，与全息量子引力核心方向相关；但摘要未涉及用户列出的多数重点标签，主要贡献在随机生长模型与强耦合引力的对偶。

2610.01862v1.title: Coherent Release Fronts in Krylov Chains and Thermal AdS$_2$ Response
2610.01862v1.abstract: We study coherent release from a finite serial Krylov sector into an exact conformal tail with asymptotically linear Lanczos coefficients. We derive an exact finite-cut occupation kernel and its locally uniform moving-cut limit, whose derivative is the squared modulus of a filtered boundary-emission amplitude. The tail sets the filtering kernel and logarithmic transit scale, while the release profile also depends on the finite sector. Its early edge records the number of serial steps before emission, whereas its late edge reflects slow resonances, interference, and logarithmic enhancements from merged poles. A one- and two-site family can share the same leading continued-fraction pole while exhibiting inequivalent profiles. We further consider a thermal AdS$_2$ realization in which, in the weak-coupling limit, the dressed oscillator measure approaches a two-site shallow sector followed by the conformal tail, with the leading complex pole reproduced through second order.

classification.title_zh: Krylov链中的相干释放前沿与热AdS2响应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究从有限串联Krylov扇区向具有渐近线性Lanczos系数的精确共形尾部的相干释放。我们推导出精确的有限截断占据核及其局部均匀移动截断极限，其导数是滤波后的边界发射振幅的模平方。尾部设定了滤波核和对数过渡尺度，而释放剖面还依赖于有限扇区。其早期边缘记录了发射前的串联步数，而晚期边缘反映了慢共振、干涉以及来自合并极点的对数增强。一个单格点和双格点族可以共享相同的主导连分式极点，却表现出不等价的剖面。我们进一步考虑一种热AdS2实现，其中在弱耦合极限下，缀饰振子测度趋近于一个双格点浅扇区后接共形尾部，且主导复极点通过二阶重现。
classification.one_liner: 用Krylov链描述向共形尾部的相干释放，并在热AdS2弱耦合实现中重现主导复极点。
classification.relevance_reason: 涉及AdS2、Krylov链、边界发射与响应，与全息及量子信息/非平衡方向相关，但不直接匹配用户重点标签中的全息超导、探针膜、经典引力等具体支线。

2610.01909v1.title: Super Liouville theory on the torus: bootstrap and the super Virasoro minimal string
2610.01909v1.abstract: Motivated by applications to low-dimensional worldsheet string constructions, we analyze $\mathcal{N} = 1$ super Liouville theory on the torus. Specifically, we re-examine the recursive representations of the torus one-point super Virasoro blocks that have been constructed in the literature and correct several of their ingredients. In the process we identify a new block in the odd spin structure, associated with a privileged superdescendant whose torus one-point function transforms like that of a Virasoro primary. We then demonstrate that the structure constants for both spacelike and timelike super Liouville theory satisfy modular crossing. Furthermore, we use a bootstrap argument to construct modular crossing kernels for all four spin structure sectors, valid for central charges $c \in \mathbb{C}\setminus(-\infty,\tfrac{3}{2}]$, and verify that they correctly implement the crossing transformations of the blocks. As a concrete application of the technology, we analyze the super Virasoro minimal string. There are four such theories, $\mathrm{0A}^{\pm}$ and $\mathrm{0B}^{\pm}$, which are distinguished by the GSO projection together with the choice of worldsheet supercharge. The resulting NS-sector sphere three-point and torus one-point amplitudes are shown to agree with topological recursion on the spectral curves of the dual matrix integrals, which were recently derived from 3d supergravity. Notably, the one-point function of the privileged superdescendant plays an essential role in the contribution of the odd spin structure to the torus amplitude via a careful treatment of the picture changing operator. We also identify an exceptional zero-momentum Ramond insertion in the $\mathrm{0A}^{-}$ theory that we interpret geometrically as a Ramond puncture, and match its mixed sphere three-point amplitude to the corresponding intersection theory prediction.

classification.title_zh: 环面上的超 Liouville 理论：bootstrap 与超 Virasoro 极小弦
classification.abstract_zh: 受低维世界面弦构造应用的启发，我们分析环面上的 N=1 超 Liouville 理论。具体而言，我们重新审视文献中已构造的环面单点超 Virasoro 块的递推表示，并修正其中若干要素。在此过程中，我们在奇自旋结构中发现一个新块，它与一个特殊的超后裔相关，其环面单点函数像 Virasoro 原初场一样变换。随后我们证明类空和类时超 Liouville 理论的结构常数均满足模交叉。进一步，我们使用 bootstrap 论证构造适用于所有四个自旋结构扇区的模交叉核，有效中心荷 c∈C\(-∞,3/2]，并验证它们正确实现块的交叉变换。作为该技术的具体应用，我们分析超 Virasoro 极小弦。共有四个此类理论，0A± 与 0B±，由 GSO 投影以及世界面超荷选择区分。所得 NS 扇区球面三点和环面单点振幅被证明与对偶矩阵积分的谱曲线上的拓扑递归一致，而这些矩阵积分最近由 3d 超引力导出。值得注意的是，通过仔细处理 picture changing operator，特殊超后裔的单点函数在奇自旋结构对环面振幅的贡献中起关键作用。我们还识别出 0A− 理论中一个例外的零动量 Ramond 插入，将其几何解释为 Ramond 穿刺，并将其混合球面三点振幅与相应的相交理论预言匹配。
classification.one_liner: 在环面上重构 N=1 超 Liouville 的自举与模交叉核，并应用于超 Virasoro 极小弦及其对偶矩阵积分/3d 超引力。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于二维引力/极小弦与矩阵模型的理论前沿，与 JT/SYK/AdS2/矩阵模型支线相关；但不直接涉及用户列出的全息超导、p波、畴壁、multi-trace、QNM 或经典引力等重点标签。

2610.01976v1.title: Trinity of Carrollian Gravity: Dynamically Equivalent Formulations of Magnetic Carrollian Gravity
2610.01976v1.abstract: In this paper, we extend the paradigm of the Geometrical Trinity of Gravity to the Carrollian geometry to construct a comprehensive framework of dynamically equivalent theories for Magnetic Carrollian gravity. Utilizing the inherent ambiguities and freedoms of affine connections on degenerate metrics, we systematically relax the metric-compatibility and zero-torsion constraints of the rigid magnetic sector. By imposing global flatness on these modified connections, we prove that the curvature of a Magnetic Carrollian universe can be dynamically traded for isolated kinetic energy densities of torsion and non-metricity. Unlike the Lorentzian Trinity which maps gravity to alternative gravitational frameworks, the Carrollian equivalences can also map spacetime geometry to non-gravitational theories. Specifically, we demonstrate that intrinsic torsion recovers Electric Carrollian gravity as the Teleparallel equivalent of Magnetic Carroll gravity; purely spatial torsion reproduces kinetic terms stracturally similar to the magnetic Hamiltonian of scalar-charge Fracton gauge theory; and temporal torsion sectors map independently to $U(1)$ Maxwell electric fields and Carroll-Weyl conformal dilaton theories. Finally, by formulating a Symmetric Teleparallel Carroll connection with minimal non-metricity, we show that the Magnetic Carrollian Lagrangian is dynamically equivalent to an ultralocal, isotropic Electric Carrollian gravity upon exploiting the present freedoms in connection. These results establish a geometric dictionary translating Carrollian gravitational dynamics into the language of tensor gauge theories, electromagnetism, and dilaton theory.

classification.title_zh: 卡罗尔引力的三位一体：磁卡罗尔引力的动力学等价表述
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们将引力的几何三位一体范式推广到卡罗尔几何，以构建磁卡罗尔引力的动力学等价理论的综合框架。利用退化度规上仿射联络的固有模糊性和自由度，我们系统地放松了刚性磁扇区的度规相容性和零挠率约束。通过在这些修改后的联络上施加整体平坦性，我们证明磁卡罗尔宇宙的曲率可以动力学地交换为挠率和非度规性的孤立动能密度。与将引力映射到替代引力框架的洛伦兹三位一体不同，卡罗尔等价也可以将时空几何映射到非引力理论。具体而言，我们证明内禀挠率恢复电卡罗尔引力，作为磁卡罗尔引力的远平行等价；纯空间挠率再现结构上类似于标量荷分形子规范理论的磁哈密顿量的动能项；时间挠率扇区独立映射到 U(1) 麦克斯韦电场和卡罗尔-外尔共形伸缩子理论。最后，通过构造具有最小非度规性的对称远平行卡罗尔联络，我们表明，在利用联络中现有自由度的情况下，磁卡罗尔拉格朗日量动力学等价于超局域、各向同性的电卡罗尔引力。这些结果建立了一个几何词典，将卡罗尔引力动力学翻译为张量规范理论、电磁学和伸缩子理论的语言。
classification.one_liner: 将引力几何三位一体推广到卡罗尔几何，证明磁卡罗尔引力的曲率可等价转化为挠率/非度规性动能项，并映射到张量规范理论、麦克斯韦场和伸缩子理论。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/卡罗尔几何与平直时空表述，使用几何三位一体、远平行和非度规性讨论磁卡罗尔引力的等价理论；与全息对偶无直接关系，但涉及 BMS-Carroll/平直时空主题并属于经典引力重点方向。

2610.02063v1.title: Rotation and Anisotropic Scaling in Axionic Holographic Superconductors: AdS$_4$ versus Lifshitz$_5$
2610.02063v1.abstract: An outstanding question in holographic superconductivity is how rotation and non-relativistic scaling symmetries compete to modify the onset of condensation. We address this by comparing the probe superconductor sectors of two exact rotating axionic black holes: a four-dimensional asymptotically anti-de Sitter solution dressed by a non-minimally coupled scalar, and a five-dimensional asymptotically Lifshitz solution with $z \in (2,3)$. Writing both metrics in a common stationary form yields a master scalar equation in which rotation enters through the co-rotating potential $A_t-N^xA_x$. This equation explains why the temporal and spatial components of the probe gauge field cannot be treated independently. The numerical profiles reported in [1,2] indicate that the correlated deformation associated with rotation reduces the condensate amplitude in both backgrounds, whereas increasing the dynamical exponent at fixed $J$ enhances the Lifshitz condensate. Since the parameters $\alpha$ and $J$ also modify the matter fields supporting the corresponding exact geometries, these trends should be interpreted as properties of complete correlated families rather than as universal effects of mechanical rotation alone.
