2610.03495v1.title: Carrollian Worldsheets on Carrollian Targets, When does ILST describe a null string theory?
2610.03495v1.abstract: Null string theory (NST) is a two-dimensional (2d) sigma-model on a Carrollian worldsheet with 2d diffeomorphisms, Weyl and Carroll-Weyl (CW) scalings as gauge symmetries whereas the Isberg-Lindstr\"om-Sundborg-Theodoridis (ILST) theory on a generic target space only realizes the first two and not the CW gauge symmetry. We show in this work that NST on the Carrollian target spaces (CTS) is well-defined if the background admits a homothetic kernel generator and that, it is described by the ILST theory on the same CTS. To this end, we formulate a minimal null string theory on CTS, starting from first principles and then discuss beyond minimal theories as deformations away from minimality. We study some classes of such deformations involving the clock one-from for ruled Carrollian spaces and/or connection on the Carrollian space. We discuss implications of this for the recently introduced null string holography. As examples CTS, we briefly discuss null strings probing black hole horizons and the null string holography in this context.

classification.title_zh: Carrollian 靶空间上的 Carrollian 世界面：ILST 何时描述零弦理论？
classification.abstract_zh: 零弦理论（NST）是 Carrollian 世界面上的二维 sigma 模型，其规范对称性包括二维微分同胚、Weyl 缩放和 Carroll-Weyl（CW）缩放；而一般靶空间上的 ILST 理论只实现前两种，不包括 CW 规范对称性。本文表明，在 Carrollian 靶空间（CTS）上，如果背景具有 homothetic kernel generator，则 NST 是良定义的，并且可由同一 CTS 上的 ILST 理论描述。为此，我们从第一性原理构造 CTS 上的最小零弦理论，并讨论超出最小理论的形变。我们研究了几类此类形变，涉及 ruled Carrollian 空间的 clock one-form 和/或 Carrollian 空间上的联络。我们讨论这对近期引入的零弦全息的意义。作为 CTS 的例子，我们简要讨论探测黑洞视界的零弦以及此背景下的零弦全息。
classification.one_liner: 证明在具有 homothetic kernel generator 的 Carrollian 靶空间上，零弦理论可由 ILST 理论描述，并讨论其对零弦全息的启示。

2610.03606v1.title: Non-Renormalizability Properties of Quarter-BPS Correlators in $\mathcal{N}$=4 SYM
2610.03606v1.abstract: We study extremal and next-to-extremal four-point correlators involving general quarter-BPS operators in $\mathcal{N}$=4 Super Yang-Mills. Using a combination of $R$-symmetry considerations, operator product expansion content, and analytic superspace techniques, we show that such correlators get contributions only from operators belonging to short and semi-short multiplets. This result together with the non-renormalizability of the relevant three-point functions guarantees that all such four-point correlators are protected from quantum corrections.

classification.title_zh: N=4 SYM 中四分之一 BPS 关联函数的非重整化性质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 N=4 超杨-米尔斯理论中涉及一般四分之一 BPS 算符的 extremal 和 next-to-extremal 四点关联函数。结合 R 对称性考虑、算符乘积展开内容以及解析超空间技术，我们证明此类关联函数只受到短多重态和半短多重态算符的贡献。这一结果连同相关三点函数的非重整化性，保证了所有此类四点关联函数免受量子修正。
classification.one_liner: 利用 R 对称性、OPE 与解析超空间证明一般四分之一 BPS 的 extremal/next-to-extremal 四点关联函数只由短与半短多重态贡献，从而不受量子修正。

2610.03652v1.title: Quantum Gravity from Gluing Consistency: AdS/CFT to Spin-Foams
2610.03652v1.abstract: We argue that BF theory with $SO(d+1,1)$ gauge group provides a SymTFT ''skeleton'' for building AdS$_{d+1}$/CFT$_d$ pairs via gluing consistency as the bootstrap principle, loosely analogous to how compact Chern-Simons theory is a TQFT skeleton for rational CFTs. This is a non-perturbative $bulk$ framework for quantum gravity. The bootstrap is formulated as presentation independence of physical amplitudes within a universal, defect-closed BF sewing calculus, which includes Wilson lines, codimension-two monodromy defects, and their junctions. The flat BF connection encodes the conformal geometry of the boundary, while Wilson-line path integrals construct candidate quantum-gravity microstates and charge sectors. When the bootstrapped spectrum has a stress tensor, Ward identities naturally connect it to the $B$-field, a relation we call generalized simplicity. In large-$N$, large-gap regimes admitting a gravitational EFT, this motivates the introduction of an effective notion of the $B$-field. In the Einstein limit, this becomes the ''simplicity'' relation used in spin-foam models. Conventional spin-foam models reach gravity by constraining BF theory. We suggest instead that BF theory is the Platonic sewing skeleton, from which theories are to be bootstrapped. Despite the topological nature of the skeleton, perturbative local bulk fields can emerge via Wilson-towers of multi-trace primaries, reproducing their one-loop determinants. We note that the BF Fourier kernel is a suggestive higher-dimensional analogue of the modular-$S$ structure. Because the bulk gluing principle in itself does not require a boundary description, the framework is conceptually broader than AdS/CFT. We sketch how de Sitter space may fit into this picture, with a natural role for observers. Our approach elevates gluing consistency to a universal bulk principle underlying theories of quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: 从粘合一致性看量子引力：从 AdS/CFT 到自旋泡沫
classification.abstract_zh: 我们认为，具有 SO(d+1,1) 规范群的 BF 理论提供了一个 SymTFT“骨架”，可通过作为自举原理的粘合一致性来构造 AdS_{d+1}/CFT_d 对偶，粗略类比于紧致 Chern-Simons 理论作为 rational CFT 的 TQFT 骨架。这是一个非微扰的体量子引力框架。该自举被表述为：在一个普适的、对缺陷封闭的 BF 缝合演算中，物理振幅具有表示无关性；该演算包括 Wilson 线、余二维单值缺陷及其交汇。平坦 BF 联络编码边界的共形几何，而 Wilson 线路径积分构造候选的量子引力微观态和电荷 sector。当自举得到的谱含有应力张量时，Ward 恒等式自然地将其与 B 场联系起来，我们称此关系为广义 simplicity。在允许引力 EFT 的大 N、大 gap 区域，这促使引入有效 B 场概念。在 Einstein 极限下，这变为自旋泡沫模型中使用的“simplicity”关系。传统自旋泡沫模型通过约束 BF 理论到达引力。我们反而建议 BF 理论是柏拉图式的缝合骨架，理论应从中被自举出来。尽管骨架是拓扑的，微扰局域体场可以通过多迹 primary 的 Wilson 塔涌现，并复现其一圈行列式。我们指出 BF Fourier 核是 modular-S 结构的一个有启发性的高维类比。由于体粘合原理本身不需要边界描述，该框架在概念上比 AdS/CFT 更广。我们勾勒 de Sitter 空间如何能纳入这一图景，并赋予观察者自然角色。我们的方法将粘合一致性提升为量子引力理论背后的普适体原理。
classification.one_liner: 提出以 SO(d+1,1) BF 理论为 SymTFT 骨架，通过粘合一致性自举 AdS/CFT 与自旋泡沫等量子引力理论，并讨论其向 de Sitter 的推广。

2609.40176v1.title: Is DESI Seeing Dynamical Dark Energy, or a Cosmic Glitch in Gravity?
2609.40176v1.abstract: Combined baryon acoustic oscillation and cosmic microwave background data have begun to mildly favor departures from $\Lambda\mathrm{CDM}$. This is usually framed as 2-parameter dynamical dark energy. However, a 1-parameter "cosmic glitch in gravity" model, whose cosmological gravitational coupling differs from Newton's constant as in Ho\v{r}ava gravity, fits at least as well. $\textit{Planck}$+ACT+SPT and DESI~DR2 give $G_\mathrm{cosmo}/G_\mathrm{N}=0.9920\pm0.0025$, a $3.3\,\sigma$ preference for weaker cosmological gravity, robust to adding CMB lensing and supernovae. Fitted to the CMB alone, the glitch predicts DESI distances; $w_0w_a$CDM does not.

classification.title_zh: DESI 看到的是动力学暗能量，还是引力中的宇宙学故障？
classification.abstract_zh: 结合重子声学振荡与宇宙微波背景数据已开始略微偏向偏离 ΛCDM。这通常被表述为双参数动力学暗能量。然而，一个单参数“引力中的宇宙学故障”模型——其宇宙学引力耦合不同于牛顿常数，如 Hořava 引力中那样——至少拟合得同样好。Planck+ACT+SPT 与 DESI DR2 给出 G_cosmo/G_N=0.9920±0.0025，即对更弱宇宙学引力有 3.3σ 偏好，且在加入 CMB 透镜和超新星后仍稳健。仅拟合 CMB 时，该故障模型能预言 DESI 距离；w0waCDM 不能。
classification.one_liner: 单参数“引力宇宙故障”模型可替代动力学暗能量，并能从 CMB 预言 DESI 距离。

2610.02266v1.title: Simpson-Visser regularization of the quantum Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt black hole
2610.02266v1.abstract: We study the spherical geometry from the Simpson-Visser prescription $r\to\sqrt{r^2+a^2}$ to the quantum Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt (qOSD) black hole of loop quantum cosmology, whose lapse function $A=1-2M/R+\alpha M^2/R^4$ carries the correction $\alpha$. This family interpolates between the qOSD black hole ($a\to0$), the Simpson-Visser black bounce ($\alpha\to0$), and Schwarzschild. The geometry is regular for every $a>0$, the Ricci scalar at the throat is blind to $\alpha$ while the Kretschmann scalar is not, and the null energy condition is violated at the throat by $-1/(4\pi a^2)$. The $(\alpha,a)$ plane splits into a two-horizon regular black hole, a single-horizon black hole with a hidden bounce, no Cauchy horizon, and a traversable wormhole; the middle region removes the mass-inflation channel of regular black holes without fine tuning. Because circular orbits are governed by the areal radius, photon sphere, shadow, ISCO and azimuthal epicyclic frequency depend on $\alpha$ only, whereas the Lyapunov exponent and radial epicyclic frequency carry the factor $\sqrt{1-a^2/R^2}$: shadow constrains only $\alpha$, while ringdown damping and the twin-peak quasiperiodic-oscillation ratio are sensitive to $a$. We derive horizon thermodynamics with a first-law entropy that departs from the area law, show that the bounce changes the thermodynamic topological charge from $W=-1$ to $W=0$ at every $\alpha$, and compute scalar, electromagnetic and Dirac quasinormal spectra using third-order WKB, Chebyshev spectral collocation and time-domain integration, which agree with one another and with eikonal scaling. Greybody bounds, Hawking emission, cascade sparsity and ringdown quality factor complete the analysis, and in the wormhole region the double-peaked potential produces echoes.

classification.title_zh: 量子 Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt 黑洞的 Simpson-Visser 正则化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了将 Simpson-Visser 规定 $r\to\sqrt{r^2+a^2}$ 应用于圈量子宇宙学中的量子 Oppenheimer-Snyder-Datt (qOSD) 黑洞后得到的球对称几何，其时移函数 $A=1-2M/R+\alpha M^2/R^4$ 带有修正 $\alpha$。该族在 qOSD 黑洞 ($a\to0$)、Simpson-Visser 黑洞反弹 ($\alpha\to0$) 和 Schwarzschild 之间插值。对任意 $a>0$，几何是正则的；喉处的 Ricci 标量对 $\alpha$ 不敏感，而 Kretschmann 标量则不然，且零能量条件在喉处被以 $-1/(4\pi a^2)$ 破坏。$(\alpha,a)$ 平面划分为双视界正则黑洞、带隐藏反弹的单视界黑洞、无 Cauchy 视界以及可穿越虫洞；中间区域无需精细调节就移除了正则黑洞的质量膨胀通道。由于圆轨道由面积半径决定，光子球、阴影、ISCO 和方位角本轮频率仅依赖 $\alpha$，而 Lyapunov 指数和径向本轮频率带有因子 $\sqrt{1-a^2/R^2}$：阴影只限制 $\alpha$，而铃宕阻尼和双峰准周期振荡比对 $a$ 敏感。我们推导了视界热力学，其第一定律熵偏离面积律；表明反弹在每个 $\alpha$ 下都将热力学拓扑荷从 $W=-1$ 变为 $W=0$；并使用三阶 WKB、Chebyshev 谱配置法和时域积分计算了标量、电磁和 Dirac 准正规模谱，它们相互一致并与 eikonal 标度一致。灰体界限、Hawking 辐射、级联稀疏度和铃宕品质因子完成了分析；在虫洞区域，双峰势产生回声。

2409.07531v2.title: Identifying sea and valence quarks in a magnetically driven catalysis
2409.07531v2.abstract: In the present work, we study the magnetic response of a holographic plasma in a D3/D7 setup through the quasinormal spectrum of D7-brane embedding fluctuations. Extending the spectral analysis to nonzero spatial momentum, we show that the modes become increasingly quasiparticle-like as the kinetic momentum grows at fixed magnetic field, while increasing the field at fixed kinetic momentum suppresses this character. The possible existence of these competing effects in an actual quark-gluon plasma could account, on the one hand, for the partial success of quasiparticle-based effective descriptions due to the presence of a substantial population of modes stabilized by their high momentum, and, on the other, for the difficulty of isolating experimental signatures of such constituents because of the magnetic suppression that dominates at low momentum. Within the same setup, we introduce a holographic prescription to describe the contribution of valence and sea quarks to the phenomena of magnetic catalysis and its inverse, characterized herein through the induced expectation value of a scalar operator. We apply this prescription at vanishing spatial momentum to perform an initial calculation leading to results that are in agreement with those obtained from lattice QCD.

classification.title_zh: 在磁场驱动的催化中识别海夸克与价夸克
classification.abstract_zh: 本文在D3/D7全息模型中，通过D7膜嵌入涨落的准正态谱研究全息等离子体的磁响应。我们将谱分析推广到非零空间动量，表明在固定磁场下，随着动能动量增大，模式越来越像准粒子；而在固定动能动量下增大磁场会抑制这种特性。这些竞争效应若存在于实际夸克-胶子等离子体中，一方面可解释基于准粒子的有效描述为何部分成功——存在大量由高动量稳定的模式；另一方面也可解释为何难以分离出这类组分的实验信号——低动量时磁场抑制占主导。在同一模型中，我们引入一种全息方案，用以描述价夸克和海夸克对磁催化及其逆现象的贡献，并通过标量算符的诱导期望值来刻画。我们在零空间动量下应用该方案进行初步计算，结果与格点QCD一致。
classification.one_liner: 在D3/D7全息模型中利用D7膜嵌入涨落的准正态谱研究磁场对等离子体准粒子行为的影响，并提出区分价夸克与海夸克对磁催化贡献的全息处方。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接采用D3-D7探针膜与D7膜嵌入涨落的准正态谱，属于用户重点关注的D3-D7探针膜与QNM方向；同时涉及全息QCD磁催化。

2509.18651v2.title: One loop aspects of Coleman de Luccia instantons at small backreaction
2509.18651v2.abstract: We discuss the Euclidean path integral around Coleman de Luccia instantons. We compute their contribution at the one-loop level, at leading order in the small backreaction limit. At this level of approximation, their contribution factorizes into a pure gravity and a pure matter contribution. In deriving this result, we also clarify what happens to some zero mode contributions to the path integral, once the symmetry responsible for them is broken. With these results established, we propose a formula for the decay rate of the false vacuum in terms of gravitational path integrals, and we show that our definition matches the usual quantum field theory result as $G_{N}\rightarrow0$. Lastly, we propose a prescription to study how the phase of the gravity+matter path integral changes as we change the parameters of the theory.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 小反作用极限下 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子的一圈效应
classification.abstract_zh: 我们讨论围绕 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子的欧几里得路径积分。我们在小反作用极限的领头阶计算它们的一圈贡献。在此近似水平下，它们的贡献分解为纯引力部分和纯物质部分。在推导这一结果时，我们也澄清了当导致零模贡献的对称性破缺后，路径积分中某些零模贡献会发生什么。建立这些结果后，我们提出一个用引力路径积分表示假真空衰变率的公式，并表明我们的定义在 G_N→0 时与通常量子场论结果一致。最后，我们提出一套方案来研究引力加物质路径积分的相位如何随理论参数变化。
classification.one_liner: 在小反作用极限下一圈计算 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子对假真空衰变的贡献，并给出引力路径积分表述。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 Coleman-de Luccia 瞬子、假真空衰变和气泡成核的一圈引力路径积分，并给出引力路径积分衰变率公式，与“相变与气泡成核”及“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签高度相关。

2606.28408v2.title: Quantum Black Hole Chemistry from Double Holography
2606.28408v2.abstract: Extended black hole thermodynamics highlights a sharp tension in the usual holographic dictionary: at fixed boundary conformal frame, changing the AdS radius changes both the central charge and the spatial volume of the CFT, so that the color and volume sectors of the first law becomes degenerate. We show that this degeneracy is naturally removed for quantum black holes in Karch--Randall double holography. The mechanism is intrinsically semiclassical. Replacing the holographic regulator surface by a physical brane induces gravity coupled to a cutoff CFT, so classical bulk black holes become lower-dimensional quantum black holes whose geometry includes the cutoff-matter stress tensor to all orders in backreaction. This backreacting matter sector supplies a color variable distinct from the defect volume. We demonstrate the mechanism explicitly for the quantum BTZ black hole. Thus quantum backreaction resolves the same color-volume degeneracy addressed by the recent Weyl-factor proposal, but without introducing a non-standard boundary Weyl factor. Instead, the missing thermodynamic direction is supplied by the physical cutoff-matter sector of the doubly holographic quantum black hole.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 双全息中的量子黑洞化学
classification.abstract_zh: 扩展黑洞热力学凸显了通常全息字典中的尖锐矛盾：在固定边界共形框架下，改变 AdS 半径会同时改变 CFT 的中心荷和空间体积，使第一定律中的色部门与体积部门简并。我们表明，在 Karch-Randall 双全息中，量子黑洞自然消除这一简并。该机制本质上是半经典的：用物理膜替代全息正则化面会诱导出与截断 CFT 耦合的引力，因此经典体黑洞变为低维量子黑洞，其几何在所有反作用阶都包含截断物质应力张量。这个反作用物质部门提供了一个不同于缺陷体积的色变量。我们对量子 BTZ 黑洞明确展示了该机制。因此，量子反作用解决了最近 Weyl 因子提议所处理的同一色-体积简并问题，但无需引入非标准的边界 Weyl 因子；缺失的热力学方向由双全息量子黑洞的物理截断物质部门提供。
classification.one_liner: Karch-Randall 双全息中，量子反作用通过截断物质部门消除扩展黑洞热力学的色-体积简并。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于 AdS/CFT 与黑洞热力学交叉，但未直接涉及所列全息超导、探针膜、QNM、冷原子等具体重点支线。

2512.18795v5.title: Physical properties of compact star-like systems harboring traversable wormholes: Effects of chaotic magnetic fields and anisotropic matter
2512.18795v5.abstract: In this paper, we formulate exotic compact objects in form of compact star-like systems harboring traversable wormhole (CSSTW) supported by two scalar fields, allowing for both chaotic magnetic field and pressure anisotropy of the neutron fluid. The wormhole is traversable regardless of whether anisotropy of the neutron fluid and/or magnetic fields are included. In particular, the null energy condition (NEC) remains violated in the vicinity of the wormhole throat, ensuring the traversable nature of the geometry. The Kretschmann scalars for all considered configurations show that the entire spacetime is regular. The temporal metric functions for all considered configurations show that there are no horizons in any of the considered cases. For magnetized configurations, the resulting CSSTW can become extremely massive, with ADM masses exceeding $8\,M_\odot$, and can exhibit large surface redshifts exceeding $\mathcal{Z} \simeq 1.5$. The system can also reach the ultracompact regime, which allows us to calculate echo time that might be produced the systems. Our calculations of the echo time indicate that it can vary depending on the chaotic magnetic field configuration and fluid anisotropy. For non-magnetized configurations, the gravitational-wave echo time is of the order of $10^{-2}-10^{-1}$ ms. For the magnetized configurations, however, it ranges from the order of $10^{-1}$ $\mu$s $-10^{-1}$ ms, suggesting that magnetic fields broaden the range of echo time. Moreover, to investigate the direct impact of the magnetic field on the echo time, we derive an explicit expression for the echo time as a function of uniform magnetic field. The resulting relation shows that the echo time decreases as the magnetic field strength increases. The stability analysis of radial perturbations shows that all considered configurations with a surface magnetic field of $B_s=10^{15}$~G are stable.

classification.title_zh: 携带可穿越虫洞的致密星状系统的物理性质：混沌磁场与各向异性物质的影响
classification.abstract_zh: 本文构建了一类奇异致密天体——携带可穿越虫洞的致密星状系统（CSSTW），由两个标量场支持，并允许中子流体具有混沌磁场和压强各向异性。无论是否包含中子流体各向异性或磁场，虫洞都是可穿越的。特别地，在虫洞喉附近零能量条件（NEC）仍被违反，从而保证几何的可穿越性。所有构型的Kretschmann标量表明整个时空是规则的。时间度规函数表明所有考虑情形均无事件视界。对于磁化构型，所得CSSTW可以极其巨大，ADM质量超过8 M⊙，并表现出超过约1.5的大表面红移。系统还可达到超致密区域，从而允许计算可能产生的回声时间。回声时间计算表明，它可随混沌磁场构型和流体各向异性而变化。对于非磁化构型，引力波回声时间约为10^{-2}-10^{-1} ms。对于磁化构型，其范围约为10^{-1} μs至10^{-1} ms，表明磁场拓宽了回声时间范围。此外，为研究磁场对回声时间的直接影响，我们推导了回声时间作为均匀磁场函数的显式表达式。所得关系表明，回声时间随磁场强度增加而减小。径向微扰稳定性分析表明，所有表面磁场为B_s=10^15 G的考虑构型都是稳定的。
classification.one_liner: 在含混沌磁场和各向异性中子流体的致密星状可穿越虫洞中，考察NEC违反、规则性、质量/红移、回声时标与径向稳定性。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究虫洞与致密星状系统；不涉及AdS/CFT全息对偶，故对全息分类任务关联中等。

2603.20482v2.title: Uncertainty quantification of holographic transport and energy loss for the hot and baryon-dense QGP
2603.20482v2.abstract: We investigate several transport coefficients across the phase diagram of a holographic Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) model of hot and dense QCD with $N_f=2+1$ flavors. Our results are obtained from an open-source implementation of this model in C++, publicly available as a module within the MUSES Framework. This code includes a new numerical method to extract thermodynamic quantities from near-boundary asymptotics in holographic models, introduced here for the first time, which greatly improves numerical stability and performance in comparison to earlier implementations. Thanks to this improved technique, we are able to compute results for many realizations of our holographic model, sampled from a Bayesian posterior distribution constrained by lattice QCD results at zero chemical potential. This allows us to propagate lattice QCD error bars to predictions of transport coefficients in a wide window of temperature and baryon chemical potential, covering the crossover region, the neighborhood of the predicted critical point, and the line of first-order phase transition. The physical observables include baryon and thermal conductivities, baryon diffusion, shear and bulk viscosities, the jet-quenching parameter, the heavy-quark drag force, and Langevin diffusion coefficients. At vanishing baryon density, we compare our results to estimates extracted by the JETSCAPE Collaboration from heavy-ion data, with which we find good agreement.

secondary_topics: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 热且重子致密 QGP 的全息输运与能量损失的不确定性量化
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了具有 N_f=2+1 味的热密 QCD 的全息 Einstein-Maxwell-Dilaton (EMD) 模型相图中的若干输运系数。我们的结果来自该模型的一个开源 C++ 实现，该实现作为 MUSES 框架内的一个模块公开可用。该代码包含一种新的数值方法，用于从全息模型的近边界渐近行为中提取热力学量，本文首次引入该方法，与早期实现相比，它极大地提高了数值稳定性和性能。得益于这一改进技术，我们能够针对从受零化学势格点 QCD 结果约束的贝叶斯后验分布中采样得到的该全息模型的许多实现进行计算。这使我们能够将格点 QCD 误差棒传播到宽温度与重子化学势窗口内输运系数的预言，涵盖 crossover 区域、预言临界点附近以及一阶相变线。物理观测量包括重子电导率和热导率、重子扩散、剪切与体粘度、喷注淬火参数、重夸克拖曳力以及 Langevin 扩散系数。在零重子密度下，我们将结果与 JETSCAPE 合作组从重离子数据中提取的估计值进行比较，发现二者符合良好。
classification.one_liner: 在 MUSES 框架内基于开源 EMD 全息模型，对热密 QCD 相图输运系数进行贝叶斯不确定性量化，并与 JETSCAPE 数据符合良好。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于全息 QCD/核物理中的输运系数与能量损失研究，主要面向热密 QGP 相图与贝叶斯不确定性量化；未直接涉及用户重点标签中的全息超流超导、p波与多分量序参量、畴壁/孤子/涡旋/非均匀、multi-trace、相变与气泡成核（尽管涉及相变线，但非气泡成核动力学）、QNM与非线性演化、冷原子/双组分BEC、D3-D7/D3-D5探针膜与Floquet驱动或经典引力/广义相对论等支线。

2606.10647v2.title: Hawking-Page phase transition for pure Lovelock black holes
2606.10647v2.abstract: We investigate the thermodynamic properties of static, spherically symmetric Anti-de Sitter (AdS) black holes, focusing on the interplay between characteristic temperatures, as well as on the universality of Ruppeiner scalar curvature at the Hawking-Page (HP) phase transition. In particular, we study the relation between the minimum temperature and the HP phase transition temperature for static, spherically symmetric AdS black holes in pure Lovelock gravity. For the electromagnetically neutral case in Einstein gravity, the minimum temperature in $(d+1)$ dimensions coincides with the HP transition temperature in $d$ dimensions, while in higher pure Lovelock theories this relation is modified by a dimension- and order-dependent factor, reducing to the Einstein result in appropriate limits. For charged AdS black holes, in the grand canonical ensemble, in general relativity, the two temperatures differ by a simple dimension-dependent factor, whereas no universal relation persists in higher curvature pure Lovelock theories. We further analyze the normalized Ruppeiner scalar curvature at the HP transition and show that it is a universal constant depending only on the spacetime dimension for electromagnetically neutral black holes in pure Lovelock theories. The normalized scalar curvature remains a constant, under appropriate conditions, even for the charged static spherically symmetric black holes in the grand canonical ensemble for the Einstein theory case, whereas in general pure Lovelock theories it depends on thermodynamic parameters such as pressure and electrostatic potential, asymptotically approaching a constant in the large-pressure or simultaneous large-potential and large-pressure limits.

classification.primary_topic: 相变/气泡成核/引力热力学
classification.title_zh: 纯 Lovelock 黑洞的 Hawking-Page 相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究静态、球对称反德西特（AdS）黑洞的热力学性质，重点考察特征温度之间的相互关系，以及 Hawking-Page（HP）相变处 Ruppeiner 标量曲率的普适性。特别地，我们研究纯 Lovelock 引力中静态球对称 AdS 黑洞的最低温度与 HP 相变温度之间的关系。对于 Einstein 引力中的电磁中性情形，(d+1) 维的最低温度与 d 维的 HP 相变温度一致；而在更高阶纯 Lovelock 理论中，这一关系被一个依赖于维度和阶数的因子修正，并在适当极限下回到 Einstein 结果。对于带电 AdS 黑洞，在巨正则系综中，广义相对论里两个温度相差一个简单的维度依赖因子，而在更高曲率纯 Lovelock 理论中不存在持续的普适关系。我们进一步分析 HP 相变处的归一化 Ruppeiner 标量曲率，并表明对于纯 Lovelock 理论中的电磁中性黑洞，它是一个仅依赖于时空维度的普适常数。对于 Einstein 理论情形下巨正则系综中的带电静态球对称黑洞，归一化标量曲率在适当条件下也保持为常数；而在一般纯 Lovelock 理论中，它依赖于压强和静电势等热力学参数，并在大压强极限或电势与压强同时很大的极限下渐近趋于常数。
classification.one_liner: 在纯 Lovelock AdS 黑洞中考察最低温度、Hawking-Page 相变温度及 Ruppeiner 曲率普适性。
classification.relevance_reason: 直接研究 AdS 黑洞的 Hawking-Page 相变与引力热力学，属于用户重点标注的“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”支线；但摘要未涉及 AdS/CFT 对偶或量子信息，因此不归为理论全息。

2609.00423v2.title: Computing the energy of some timelike singularities
2609.00423v2.abstract: The gravitational energies of timelike singularities in some asymptotically AdS spaces and in the Schwarzschild black hole with negative mass are explicitly computed. In all cases considered, the energy is finite and positive, depends on the geometry around the singularity, and compensates negative energy contributions from the asymptotic boundary, rendering the total gravitational energy positive. The definition used for energy is the on-shell Hamiltonian of the physical classical action proposed by Hawking and Horowitz~\cite{Hawking-Horowitz}. To deal with the singularity, spacetime is cut off by a timelike regulating boundary surrounding the singularity that is compatible with a foliation of spacetime in constant-time slices. It is shown that the total energy of static AdS-Kasner solutions with timelike Kasner singularities is equal to the energy of the planar AdS black hole, and that the Schwarzschild black hole with negative mass has the same energy as Minkowski space.

classification.title_zh: 计算若干类时奇点的能量
classification.abstract_zh: 本文明确计算了若干渐近 AdS 空间中的类时奇点以及负质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞的引力能量。在所有考虑的情形中，能量均为有限且为正，依赖于奇点周围的几何，并抵消来自渐近边界的负能量贡献，从而使总引力能量为正。所用能量定义是 Hawking 和 Horowitz 提出的物理经典作用量的壳上哈密顿量。为处理奇点，用一个包围奇点的类时调节边界截断时空，该边界与按常时切片进行的时空叶状分层相容。结果表明，具有类时 Kasner 奇点的静态 AdS-Kasner 解的总能量等于平面 AdS 黑洞的能量，而负质量 Schwarzschild 黑洞具有与 Minkowski 空间相同的能量。
classification.one_liner: 用 Hawking-Horowitz 壳上哈密顿量计算渐近 AdS 与负质量 Schwarzschild 时空中类时奇点的引力能量，发现能量有限为正并可抵消边界负贡献。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究奇异时空的引力能量定义与计算，匹配“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；未涉及全息对偶、量子信息或纠缠等全息研究内容。

2609.29434v2.title: The Lanczos potential in the Plebanski paradigm of gravity
2609.29434v2.abstract: We present a new Plebanski formulation of General Relativity. The key difference is that we work with a gauge vector field derived from the Lanczos potential of the Weyl tensor. We show that, on shell, the gauge vector field encodes all nontrivial gravitational degrees of freedom and, in a suitable Lorentz gauge, Bianchi identities ensure that this gauge vector field satisfies a source-free wave equation for Ricci-flat spacetimes. This description suggests new ways of interpreting the true geometrical degrees of freedom with applications in both classical and quantum gravity.

classification.title_zh: Plebanski 引力范式中的 Lanczos 势
classification.abstract_zh: 我们提出了广义相对论的一种新的 Plebanski 表述。关键区别在于，我们使用一个由 Weyl 张量的 Lanczos 势导出的规范矢量场。我们证明，在壳上该规范矢量场编码了所有非平凡的引力自由度，并且在合适的洛伦兹规范下，Bianchi 恒等式保证该规范矢量场对 Ricci 平坦时空满足无源波动方程。这一描述为理解真正的几何自由度提供了新途径，并在经典引力和量子引力中具有应用前景。
classification.one_liner: 用 Weyl 张量的 Lanczos 势构造规范矢量场，在 Plebanski 框架中重新表述广义相对论，并在 Ricci 平坦时空中导出无源波动方程。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接研究广义相对论的经典表述与几何自由度，属于用户重点标签“经典引力/广义相对论”；但未涉及 AdS/CFT 或全息对偶。

2609.34957v2.title: Horizon, Null-Orbit, and Photon-Sphere Phase Structures in Logarithmic Nonlinear Electrodynamics
2609.34957v2.abstract: We investigate static, charged, asymptotically flat black holes in logarithmic nonlinear electrodynamics (LNED) within the $(Q,\epsilon)$ parameter space. We distinguish three phase structures: the horizon geometry, the background circular null orbits, and the circular photon orbits of the effective optical geometry. All share a zero-radius boundary $Q_{nc}(\epsilon;M)=\gamma M^{2/3}\epsilon^{1/6}$, but possess distinct critical structures: the extremal curve $Q_{ext}(\epsilon;M)$ and the background merger curve $Q_{m}(\epsilon;M)$ both terminate at the bifurcation point $(Q_{b},\epsilon_{b})$, located at $r=0$. In contrast, the effective photon-orbit merger curve $Q_{m}^{ph}(\epsilon;M)$ does not pass through this point. For $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{b}$, approaching $Q_{nc}$ shrinks the horizon to zero radius, resulting in black points with non-zero, quantum-corrected entropy. Their Hawking temperature vanishes at the bifurcation point and diverges for $\epsilon>\epsilon_{b}$, except when $\eta\delta=1$, where the temperature at the bifurcation point also diverges. The background potential $V_{eff}^{bg}(r)$ develops an infinite barrier at $r=0$ without local extrema, acting as a perfect repeller. In contrast, the photon potential $V_{eff}^{ph}(r)$ is regularized with a maximum at a finite radius, acting as a partial reflector. Consequently, the black points retain photon spheres of finite radius. Away from $Q_{nc}$, for $\epsilon<\epsilon_{b}$, both geometries support horizonless structures above $Q_{ext}$; for $\epsilon\ge\epsilon_{b}$, only the optical geometry does so in the region $Q_{nc}<Q<Q_{m}^{ph}$. Non-radial geodesics are blocked from the singularity and can form metastable bound states, while radial geodesics either reach $r=0$ or escape to infinity. The critical impact parameter encodes both gravitational and optical-geometry effects, probing the distinct phase structures.

classification.title_zh: 对数非线性电动力学中的视界、零轨道与光子球相结构
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究了对数非线性电动力学（LNED）中静态、带电、渐近平直黑洞在 (Q, ε) 参数空间中的性质。我们区分了三种相结构：视界几何、背景圆形零轨道，以及有效光学几何的圆形光子轨道。它们都共享一个零半径边界 Q_nc(ε;M)=γ M^{2/3} ε^{1/6}，但具有不同的临界结构：极值曲线 Q_ext(ε;M) 和背景合并曲线 Q_m(ε;M) 都终止于位于 r=0 的分岔点 (Q_b, ε_b)。相反，有效光子轨道合并曲线 Q_m^{ph}(ε;M) 不经过该点。对于 ε≥ε_b，趋近 Q_nc 会使视界收缩到零半径，形成具有非零、量子修正熵的黑点。它们的霍金温度在分岔点消失，并在 ε>ε_b 时发散，除非 ηδ=1；此时分岔点的温度也发散。背景势 V_eff^{bg}(r) 在 r=0 处形成无限势垒，且没有局域极值，表现为完美排斥体。相比之下，光子势 V_eff^{ph}(r) 被正则化，并在有限半径处有一个最大值，表现为部分反射体。因此，这些黑点仍保留有限半径的光子球。远离 Q_nc 时，对于 ε<ε_b，两种几何都支持高于 Q_ext 的无视界结构；对于 ε≥ε_b，只有光学几何在 Q_nc<Q<Q_m^{ph} 区域支持无视界结构。非径向测地线被阻止到达奇点，并可形成亚稳束缚态，而径向测地线要么到达 r=0，要么逃逸到无穷远。临界碰撞参数同时编码了引力几何和光学几何效应，从而探测这些不同的相结构。
classification.one_liner: 在LNED黑洞的(Q,ε)参数空间中，视界、背景零轨道和有效光学光子轨道具有不同临界结构；黑点可保留有限半径光子球，临界碰撞参数可区分这些相。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论支线，研究黑洞时空、光子球、零轨道与测地线，不涉及全息对偶；与重点标签‘经典引力/广义相对论’直接相关。

2610.02317v1.title: Chaotic signatures in extreme-mass-ratio systems surrounded by bosonic environments
2610.02317v1.abstract: Extreme-mass-ratio inspirals are key gravitational-wave sources for testing strong gravity and the environments of massive black holes. While orbital motion in Kerr black hole spacetimes is integrable, realistic black holes may be surrounded by environments that break integrability. We investigate conservative orbital dynamics around rotating black holes surrounded by scalar clouds using fully nonlinear numerical solutions and an analytical post-Newtonian model. Poincar\'e sections and rotation curves reveal finite-width resonant islands, providing evidence for non-integrability even when the cloud carries only a small fraction of the black-hole mass. We show that the post-Newtonian description reproduces the dominant resonance and its island width for weak clouds, but underestimates the width in the configurations with stronger, more compact clouds examined here. Moreover, we find that for a scalar cloud as massive as the black hole, the phase space exhibits wider resonant islands as well as scattered layers indicative of chaotic motion. Together with earlier work, these results show that environmental effects can generically break the integrability of geodesic motion, motivating further study of resonance crossings and their gravitational-wave signatures once radiation reaction is included.

classification.title_zh: 玻色环境中极端质量比系统的混沌信号
classification.abstract_zh: 极端质量比旋进是检验强引力与大质量黑洞环境的关键引力波源。虽然 Kerr 黑洞时空中的轨道运动是可积的，真实黑洞可能被破坏可积性的环境所包围。我们使用完全非线性数值解和解析后牛顿模型，研究被标量云包围的旋转黑洞附近的保守轨道动力学。Poincaré 截面和旋转曲线揭示了有限宽度的共振岛，为即使云只携带黑洞质量的一小部分时也存在不可积性提供了证据。我们表明，后牛顿描述能重现弱云情形下的主导共振及其岛宽，但在本文考察的更强、更致密云构型中低估了岛宽。此外，我们发现对于质量与黑洞相当的标量云，相空间表现出更宽的共振岛以及表明混沌运动的散布层。结合此前工作，这些结果表明环境效应可以普遍地破坏测地运动的可积性，促使进一步研究共振穿越及其在包含辐射反作用后的引力波信号。
classification.one_liner: 用数值与后牛顿方法研究标量云环境中 EMRI 轨道动力学的可积性破坏与混沌共振岛。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力与引力波天体物理，研究 EMRI 在玻色环境中的轨道混沌与可积性破坏，不涉及 AdS/CFT 全息对偶。

2610.02532v1.title: Can the gravitational waves emitted by Eta Carinae be detected?
2610.02532v1.abstract: In this article, we propose a search for gravitational waves emitted by Eta Carinae using the PTA technique, not to detect a background, but rather a strong, isolated source (a task not yet accomplished). We suggest including pulsars PSR J0952-0607, PSR J1719-1438, PSR J2322-2650, and PSR J1909-3744 in the search network, as they exhibit relatively high residual-to-pulse-width ratios and spatial positions that favor the detection of tensor polarizations. The high eccentricity (0.9) of the Eta Carinae binary orbit may facilitate signal identification within the data due to the presence of harmonics in the emitted gravitational waves. It is possible that some of the raw data have already been recorded and are available; the remaining step is to analyze them against a model of the gravitational wave signal arriving at Earth from Eta Carinae.

classification.title_zh: 船底座η星发出的引力波能被探测到吗？
classification.abstract_zh: 在本文中，我们提出利用脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）技术搜寻船底座η星发出的引力波，不是探测背景，而是探测一个强而孤立的源（一项尚未完成的任务）。我们建议将脉冲星 PSR J0952-0607、PSR J1719-1438、PSR J2322-2650 和 PSR J1909-3744 纳入搜寻网络，因为它们表现出相对较高的残差与脉冲宽度之比，并且其空间位置有利于探测张量极化。船底座η星双星轨道的高偏心率（0.9）可能由于所发射引力波中存在谐波而有助于在数据中识别信号。部分原始数据可能已经被记录并可用；剩下的步骤是将其与从船底座η星到达地球的引力波信号模型进行比对分析。
classification.one_liner: 提出用脉冲星计时阵列搜寻船底座η星发出的强孤立引力波源，并建议特定脉冲星网络与利用高偏心率谐波来识别信号。
classification.relevance_reason: 该文研究经典引力波探测与脉冲星计时观测方案，不涉及AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力理论。

2610.02590v1.title: Multi-Band Constraints on Cosmic Strings: Unifying Harmonic and Burst Spectra
2610.02590v1.abstract: Cosmic-string loops generate a broadband gravitational-wave background (GWB) that is typically modeled via two distinct formalisms: a discrete harmonic expansion, commonly used in pulsar-timing-array (PTA) studies, and a continuous burst superposition, employed in ground-based GWB searches. In this work, we formally unify the two formalisms, showing that they provide discrete and continuous representations of the same underlying radiation process and converge on the scale-invariant spectrum plateau. On the rising low-frequency branch, where the first few harmonics dominate, the discrete nature becomes important, causing the two formalisms to diverge. Within this unified framework, the spectral calculation is more consistent across frequency bands, enabling multi-band inference. Leveraging this physical insight, we perform joint Bayesian inference across four representative loop-distribution models using the NANOGrav, EPTA, and LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA (LVK) datasets. By jointly sampling the string tension $G\mu$ alongside the average cusp and kink numbers $\{N_c, N_k\}$, the loop-radiation uncertainties are accounted for. We find that employing the harmonic expansion strengthens the LVK bounds by $21\%-31\%$ for three of these models. Additionally, the stringent LVK bounds preclude three of these models from explaining the observed PTA common signal. For the sole surviving model, our multi-band analysis improves the inferred limit on $G\mu$.

classification.title_zh: 宇宙弦的多波段约束：统一谐波谱与暴发谱
classification.abstract_zh: 宇宙弦环会产生宽频段引力波背景（GWB），通常通过两种不同形式建模：一种用于脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）研究的离散谐波展开，另一种用于地基 GWB 搜索的连续暴发叠加。在本工作中，我们形式化地统一了这两种形式，表明它们是对同一底层辐射过程的离散与连续表示，并在尺度不变谱平台上收敛。在上升的低频分支上，前几个谐波占主导，离散性变得重要，导致两种形式出现分歧。在这一统一框架内，谱计算在不同频段间更一致，从而能够进行多波段推断。利用这一物理洞察，我们使用 NANOGrav、EPTA 和 LIGO--Virgo--KAGRA (LVK) 数据集，对四个代表性的环分布模型进行了联合贝叶斯推断。通过联合采样弦张力 Gμ 以及平均尖点数和扭结数 {N_c, N_k}，考虑了环辐射的不确定性。我们发现，对其中三个模型，采用谐波展开使 LVK 限制增强 21%--31%。此外，严格的 LVK 限制排除了其中三个模型解释观测到的 PTA 公共信号的可能性。对于唯一存活的模型，我们的多波段分析改善了推断出的 Gμ 限制。
classification.one_liner: 统一宇宙弦引力波背景的谐波与暴发谱描述，并联合 PTA 与 LVK 数据对弦张力进行多波段贝叶斯限制。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于宇宙学与经典引力/引力波方向，研究宇宙弦产生的随机引力波背景及多波段观测限制，与经典引力/广义相对论重点支线相关；不涉及全息对偶、量子引力或量子信息。

2610.02735v1.title: Non-Gaussian timing residual skewness in pulsar timing arrays
2610.02735v1.abstract: Motivated by searches for weak primordial non-Gaussianity in the cosmic microwave background, we investigate perturbative departures from Gaussian stochastic gravitational wave background statistics using pulsar timing arrays. We consider a quadratic ansatz that shows three-point correlations at first order in the nonlinear coupling and covariance corrections at second order. We first examine the ansatz for gravitational wave helicity amplitudes. However, the timing residual bispectrum that this produces is not manifestly invariant under local polarization basis rotations for tensor and vector modes. Then, we formulate a polarization-frame-invariant phenomenological model for detector-projected amplitudes and evaluate its one-pulsar timing residual third moment with a simplified response. Our numerical benchmarks have shown that this gives a very small Gaussian-rms-normalized skewness.

classification.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的非高斯计时残差偏度
classification.abstract_zh: 受宇宙微波背景中微弱原初非高斯性搜寻的启发，我们利用脉冲星计时阵列研究对高斯随机引力波背景统计的微扰偏离。我们考虑一个二次拟设，其在非线性耦合的一阶给出三点关联，在二阶给出协方差修正。我们首先针对引力波螺旋振幅考察该拟设。然而，由此产生的计时残差双谱对张量和矢量模式而言，在局域偏振基旋转下并不显式不变。随后，我们为探测器投影振幅构造了一个偏振框架不变的唯象模型，并用简化响应评估其单脉冲星计时残差三阶矩。我们的数值基准表明，这给出一个非常小的、以高斯均方根归一化的偏度。
classification.one_liner: 研究脉冲星计时阵列中随机引力波背景的非高斯性，发现二次拟设的双谱缺乏偏振基不变性，改用偏振框架不变模型后单脉冲星计时残差偏度很小。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于脉冲星计时阵列与随机引力波背景统计/引力波现象学，可归入经典引力-引力波支线；不涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或量子引力信息问题。

2610.02900v1.title: Uniform Strong-Deflection Lensing in Near-Extremal Kerr
2610.02900v1.abstract: Strong-deflection lensing by a subextremal Kerr black hole exhibits a logarithmic critical divergence, whereas the exactly extremal prograde problem develops stronger power-law behavior. We construct a uniform asymptotic description of the transition between these regimes for prograde equatorial null geodesics. The distinguished joint near-critical and near-extremal limit occurs when the impact-parameter offset from the exact critical value is of order \(M\kappa\), where \(\kappa=\sqrt{1-a^2/M^2}\). In this limit, the Kerr radial potential reduces to a quadratic normal form, yielding an analytic crossover function that connects the subextremal logarithmic and extremal power-law regimes. We derive a matched next-to-leading-order correction and validate it against high-precision integrations of the exact Kerr geodesic equations, finding improvement for all 55 trajectories tested. The same asymptotic structure yields a higher-order image-branch law interpolating between algebraic and exponential accumulation, with crossover order scaling as \(\kappa^{-1}\). We also derive and numerically validate the corresponding image-branch coordinate-time delay law, whose high-order extremal-like limit approaches the horizon-period spacing \(4\pi M\).

classification.title_zh: 近极端 Kerr 中的均匀强偏折透镜
classification.abstract_zh: 亚极端 Kerr 黑洞的强偏折透镜表现出对数临界发散，而精确极端顺行问题则出现更强的幂律行为。我们为顺行赤道零测地线构建了这些区域之间过渡的均匀渐近描述。当碰撞参数相对于精确临界值的偏移为 Mκ 量级（其中 κ=sqrt(1-a^2/M^2)）时，出现显著的联合近临界与近极端极限。在此极限下，Kerr 径向势约化为二次正规形，给出一个解析交叉函数，连接亚极端对数区域与极端幂律区域。我们推导了匹配的次领头阶修正，并用精确 Kerr 测地线方程的高精度数值积分进行验证，在测试的全部 55 条轨道上均有改进。相同的渐近结构给出一个高阶像分支定律，在代数累积与指数累积之间插值，交叉阶数按 κ^{-1} 标度。我们还推导并数值验证了相应的像分支坐标时间延迟定律，其高阶类极端极限趋近于视界周期间距 4πM。
classification.one_liner: 构建近极端 Kerr 黑洞中连接亚极端对数发散与极端幂律行为的均匀强偏折透镜渐近理论。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文主要研究 Kerr 黑洞经典强偏折透镜与测地线渐近，直接对应经典引力/广义相对论重点标签；不涉及全息或量子引力。

2610.03701v1.title: Parity Isospectrality of the Kerr--Newman--de Sitter Black Hole
2610.03701v1.abstract: Vacuum Kerr perturbations in general relativity have identical even- and odd-parity quasinormal frequencies. We establish this parity isospectrality for linear gravitoelectromagnetic perturbations of subextremal Kerr--Newman--de Sitter black holes, without a slow-rotation or small-charge expansion. We reconstruct the radiative metric and gauge-potential perturbations directly from gauge-invariant master variables in radiation gauge, without an intermediate complex potential.

classification.title_zh: Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞的宇称等谱性
classification.abstract_zh: 在广义相对论中，真空 Kerr 扰动的偶宇称与奇宇称准正规模频率相同。我们对次极端 Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞的线性引力电磁扰动建立了这种宇称等谱性，且未使用慢旋转或小电荷展开。我们在辐射规范下直接从规范不变的主变量重构辐射度规与规范势扰动，无需引入中间复势。
classification.one_liner: 证明 Kerr–Newman–de Sitter 黑洞线性引力电磁扰动存在宇称等谱性，且不依赖慢转或小电荷近似。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典广义相对论中的黑洞扰动与准正规模研究，直接匹配“QNM与非线性演化”和“经典引力/广义相对论”重点标签；与全息对偶无直接关系。

2610.02448v1.title: Learning Approximate Isometric Embeddings for Efficient Template Placement
2610.02448v1.abstract: The sphere covering problem has broad applications in science however, exact solutions are computationally infeasible on curved, high-dimensional manifolds because distances must be evaluated using a position-dependent metric. We present $\texttt{isobank}$, a normalizing flow that learns an approximately isometric coordinate transformation, such that Euclidean distances in the latent space approximate metric-induced proper distances in the physical parameter space. This enables template placement using Euclidean distance checks in the latent space, avoiding repeated metric evaluations during placement. We evaluate $\texttt{isobank}$ in the context of gravitational wave template bank construction, where the sphere covering problem corresponds to the template placement problem. On a five-dimensional eccentric binary parameter space, $\texttt{isobank}$ reaches 97\% coverage at a maximum mismatch of $\mu=0.03$ with 23\% fewer templates than the state-of-the-art stochastic placement code $\texttt{mbank}$, which reaches 94\% coverage. Coverage is measured on independent injections drawn uniformly over the masses, spins and eccentricity, using the exact waveform match rather than the metric approximation. Training the flow takes about 2.5h and placing the bank under 1h on 32 CPU cores. $\texttt{isobank}$ is publicly available on Github https://github.com/Alexandra-Wernersson/isobank

classification.title_zh: 学习近似等距嵌入以实现高效模板放置
classification.abstract_zh: 球覆盖问题在科学中有广泛应用，然而在弯曲高维流形上精确求解在计算上不可行，因为距离必须使用依赖位置的度规来评估。我们提出 isobank，一个归一化流，学习近似等距的坐标变换，使得潜在空间中的欧氏距离近似物理参数空间中度规诱导的固有距离。这允许在潜在空间中使用欧氏距离检查进行模板放置，避免放置过程中重复的度规评估。我们在引力波模板库构建背景下评估 isobank，其中球覆盖问题对应模板放置问题。在五维偏心双星参数空间上，isobank 在最大失配 μ=0.03 时达到 97% 覆盖率，使用的模板比最先进的随机放置代码 mbank 少 23%，后者达到 94% 覆盖率。覆盖率在独立注入上测量，注入在质量、自旋和偏心率上均匀抽取，使用精确波形匹配而非度规近似。训练该流约需 2.5 小时，在 32 个 CPU 核心上放置模板库不到 1 小时。isobank 已在 GitHub 公开：https://github.com/Alexandra-Wernersson/isobank
classification.one_liner: 提出 isobank 归一化流学习近似等距嵌入，在五维偏心双星引力波模板放置中以更少模板达到更高覆盖率。
classification.relevance_reason: 属于经典引力/引力波方向，涉及引力波模板库构建；但不涉及全息、量子引力或用户列出的其他重点支线。

2511.19593v2.title: Parametrized model for gravitational waves from eccentric, precessing binary black holes: theory-agnostic tests of General Relativity with pTEOBResumS
2511.19593v2.abstract: Gravitational waves from binary black hole mergers allow us to test General Relativity in the strong-field, high-curvature regime. However, existing gravitational waves-based tests for this have so far assumed non-eccentric signal sources, limiting their range of applicability. In this work, we present pTEOBResumS, a new parametrized inspiral-merger-ringdown model for null tests of General Relativity incorporating both orbital eccentricity and spin precession, building on the effective-one-body model TEOBResumS-Dal\'i. We introduce parametrized deviations from General Relativity both in the inspiral and the merger-ringdown regimes. We validate the model through parameter estimation of synthetic signals generated with the model itself or from numerical simulations, including of systems featuring physics beyond General Relativity. We thus establish the model's consistency, demonstrate its capability to identify effects beyond General Relativity, and gauge the impact of eccentricity on the recovery of deviation parameters. We then analyze a set of binary black hole events from the first three LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA observing runs, under either the eccentric, spin-aligned or precessing, quasi-circular hypotheses, searching for deviations in the remnant black hole's fundamental quasi-normal mode. We find no statistically significant evidence for such deviations in any of the events. We combine single event results either by multiplying likelihoods, or via a hierarchical procedure;consistent with previous works, we infer a mild preference for longer quasi-normal mode damping times than expected, though the limited event sample and potential systematics reduce the significance of this finding. We find no support for orbital eccentricity among the events, save for GW200129. An eccentric description is strongly favored for this event, although this result could be influenced by data quality issues.

classification.title_zh: 偏心、进动双黑洞引力波的参数化模型：使用 pTEOBResumS 进行理论无关的广义相对论检验
classification.abstract_zh: 双黑洞并合产生的引力波可在强场、高曲率区域检验广义相对论。然而，现有基于引力波的此类检验迄今假设信号源无偏心率，限制了其适用范围。本文提出 pTEOBResumS，这是一个新的参数化旋进-并合-铃宕模型，用于广义相对论零假设检验，同时纳入轨道偏心率和自旋进动，并建立在有效单体模型 TEOBResumS-Dalí 基础上。我们在旋进和并合-铃宕阶段都引入对广义相对论的参数化偏离。我们通过用模型自身或数值模拟生成的合成信号进行参数估计来验证模型，包括包含超出广义相对论物理的系统。由此确立模型的自洽性，展示其识别超出广义相对论效应的能力，并评估偏心率对偏离参数恢复的影响。随后，我们分析来自前三轮 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 观测运行的一组双黑洞事件，在偏心、自旋对齐或进动、准圆假设下，寻找残余黑洞基频准简正模的偏离。我们在任何事件中都没有发现此类偏离的统计显著证据。我们用似然相乘或分层程序合并单事件结果；与先前工作一致，我们推断出对更长准简正模阻尼时间的轻微偏好，但有限的事件样本和潜在系统误差降低了该发现的显著性。除 GW200129 外，我们在事件中未发现对轨道偏心率的支持。对于该事件，偏心描述受到强烈偏好，尽管该结果可能受数据质量问题影响。
classification.one_liner: 提出包含偏心与自旋进动的参数化 IMR 模型 pTEOBResumS，用于双黑洞引力波中理论无关的广义相对论检验，并在 LVK 事件中搜索 QNM 偏离与偏心率证据。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文直接属于经典引力/广义相对论重点支线，涉及引力波、双黑洞、准简正模与广义相对论检验；但不是全息对偶研究。

2602.11883v2.title: A unified framework for photon and massive particle hypersurfaces in stationary spacetimes
2602.11883v2.abstract: Massive particle surfaces (MPS), introduced by Kobialko, Bogush and Gal'tsov, are timelike hypersurfaces confining the trajectories of charged massive particles with fixed Killing energy and charge-to-mass ratio, in analogy with the photon surfaces of Claudel, Virbhadra and Ellis. We study both classes in standard stationary spacetimes within a unified Finslerian framework. For Killing-invariant hypersurfaces $\mathbb{R}\times S_0$, with $S_0$ a hypersurface of a spacelike slice $S$, we prove that photon hypersurfaces and MPS are exactly those for which $S_0$ is totally geodesic with respect to the Fermat metric and to a Jacobi--Randers metric on $S$, respectively. For MPS we also give a gauge-invariant version, in terms of a Riemannian Jacobi metric and a tangency condition on the reduced magnetic field. For arbitrary timelike hypersurfaces, we give a coordinate-free formulation of the partial umbilicity characterization of MPS and, in dimension at least four and under a natural energy condition, we characterize when an MPS is quasi-umbilical in the sense of B.-Y. Chen. In the Som--Raychaudhuri spacetime of a rigidly rotating charged dust we exhibit MPS which are neither photon hypersurfaces nor quasi-umbilical. Finally, under completeness assumptions on the Jacobi--Randers metric, we prove existence and multiplicity results for proper-time parametrized solutions of the Lorentz force equation connecting a point to a flow line of the Killing field and, under compactness assumptions, existence of solutions with periodic spatial projection, possibly confined to an MPS.

classification.title_zh: 稳态时空中光子与有质量粒子超曲面的统一框架
classification.abstract_zh: Kobialko、Bogush 和 Gal'tsov 引入的有质量粒子面（MPS）是限制具有固定 Killing 能量和荷质比的带电有质量粒子轨迹的类时超曲面，类似于 Claudel、Virbhadra 和 Ellis 的光子面。我们在统一的 Finsler 框架下研究标准稳态时空中的这两类面。对于 Killing 不变超曲面 R×S0，其中 S0 是空间切片 S 的超曲面，我们证明：光子超曲面和 MPS 恰好分别是 S0 关于 Fermat 度规和 S 上的 Jacobi–Randers 度规为全测地曲面的那些情形。对 MPS 我们还给出规范不变版本，用 Riemann 型 Jacobi 度规和约化磁场的相切条件表述。对任意类时超曲面，我们给出 MPS 部分脐性刻画的坐标无关表述；在维数至少四且满足自然能量条件下，我们刻画一个 MPS 何时按 B.-Y. Chen 意义为拟脐性的。在刚性旋转带电尘埃的 Som–Raychaudhuri 时空中，我们展示既不是光子超曲面也不是拟脐性的 MPS。最后，在 Jacobi–Randers 度规的完备性假设下，我们证明连接一点到 Killing 场流线的 Lorentz 力方程固有时参数化解的存在性和多重性结果；在紧致性假设下，证明具有周期空间投影的解的存在性，这些解可能被限制在一个 MPS 上。
classification.one_liner: 在统一 Finsler 框架下，将稳态时空中的光子面与有质量粒子面刻画为空间切片上的全测地超曲面，并研究其脐性及 Lorentz 力方程解的存在性。

2603.09386v2.title: Deep Learning Search for Gravitational Waves from Compact Binary Coalescence
2603.09386v2.abstract: Gravitational-wave searches rely on a combination of methods, including matched filtering, coherent analyses, and more recent machine-learning-based pipelines. For compact binary coalescences --- where signals originate from the relativistic dynamics of compact objects --- matched filtering remains a central element, but its computational cost will increase substantially with the data volumes and parameter-space coverage required by next-generation interferometers such as the Einstein Telescope. Developing complementary strategies that reduce computational load while preserving detection performance is therefore essential. We investigate a hybrid approach that combines matched-filtering concepts with Convolutional Neural Networks, enabling efficient signal searches without relying on the usual $\chi^2$ rejection test. Using simulated data sets that include injected signals in Gaussian noise, transient noise, and physical effects not represented in the template bank --- such as eccentricity, precession and higher-order modes --- we show that the method achieves a detection efficiency comparable to or better than a standard matched-filtering search while offering a more resource-efficient pipeline in all the cases where the physics included in the signals were not represented in the template bank or when glitches were affecting the data. Conversely, the analysis also reveals some loss of detection capability for standard BNS/BBH searches in pure Gaussian noise. These results indicate that deep-learning-assisted searches can support sustainable gravitational-wave data analysis in future detector eras.

classification.title_zh: 用于致密双星并合引力波的深度学习搜索
classification.abstract_zh: 引力波搜索依赖于多种方法的组合，包括匹配滤波、相干分析以及较新的基于机器学习的流程。对于致密双星并合——其信号来源于致密天体的相对论动力学——匹配滤波仍是核心要素，但随着下一代干涉仪（如爱因斯坦望远镜）所需的数据量和参数空间覆盖度增加，其计算成本将大幅上升。因此，发展能够在保持探测性能的同时降低计算负载的互补策略至关重要。我们研究了一种将匹配滤波概念与卷积神经网络相结合的混合方法，从而无需依赖通常的 $\chi^2$ 拒绝检验即可实现高效信号搜索。使用包含高斯噪声中注入信号、瞬态噪声以及模板库未涵盖的物理效应（如偏心率、进动和高阶模式）的模拟数据集，我们表明该方法达到了与标准匹配滤波搜索相当或更好的探测效率，同时在信号中所含物理未被模板库代表或数据受毛刺影响的所有情形下，提供了更节省资源的流程。相反，该分析也揭示了在纯高斯噪声中标准 BNS/BBH 搜索时探测能力的一些损失。这些结果表明，深度学习辅助搜索可以支持未来探测器时代的可持续引力波数据分析。
classification.one_liner: 将匹配滤波思想与卷积神经网络结合，用于致密双星并合引力波搜索，并在非模板物理与毛刺场景下展现资源效率优势。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/广义相对论中的引力波数据分析与探测方法研究，与用户重点标签中的“经典引力/广义相对论”相关；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力理论。

2603.25809v2.title: Primitive recovery methods for binary neutron star mergers with tabulated equations of state in SPHINCS_BSSN
2603.25809v2.abstract: The dynamics and observable signatures of neutron star mergers are governed by physics under the most extreme conditions. They are particularly impacted by the high-density equation of state, which for the most sophisticated models is usually available in the form of tables. Numerical relativity codes usually evolve particularly well-behaved numerical ("conservative") variables, but at the price that the physically interesting ("primitive") variables need to be found at every computational element and at every integration sub-step by means of expensive (and not always successful) root-finding algorithms. We have recently developed the Lagrangian numerical relativity code SPHINCS_BSSN which evolves the spacetime on an adaptive mesh with well tested methods, but the fluid is evolved by means of freely moving particles. Since our evolution equations differ from those of conventional numerical relativity, we need to develop new conservative-to-primitive algorithms if we want to use tabulated equations of state. We present here three such algorithms: a 3D and a 2D Newton-Raphson method and a 1D root-finding algorithm based on Ridders' method. We find the 3D method to be very fast and robust with an average failure fraction in a full-blown neutron star merger simulation (with the DD2 equation of state) well below 1%. While we do not find obvious advantages for the 2D method, the 1D Ridders' method is slow, but essentially fail-safe. Therefore, we choose the 3D Newton-Raphson as default and fall back to the 1D Ridders' method as a safe "parachute".

classification.title_zh: SPHINCS_BSSN 中带表格状态方程的双中子星并合原始变量恢复方法
classification.abstract_zh: 中子星并合的动力学与可观测信号由极端条件下的物理决定，尤其受高密度状态方程影响，最精细模型通常以表格形式给出。数值相对论代码通常演化性质良好的数值（守恒）变量，但代价是必须在每个计算单元和每个积分子步通过昂贵且并非总是成功的求根算法找到物理感兴趣的（原始）变量。我们最近开发了拉格朗日数值相对论代码 SPHINCS_BSSN，它在自适应网格上用经过充分测试的方法演化时空，但流体用自由运动粒子演化。由于我们的演化方程不同于传统数值相对论，若想使用表格状态方程，需要发展新的守恒到原始变量算法。本文提出三种算法：三维和二维 Newton-Raphson 方法，以及基于 Ridders 方法的一维求根算法。我们发现三维方法快速稳健，在完整中子星并合模拟（DD2 状态方程）中平均失败比例远低于1%。二维方法未发现明显优势；一维 Ridders 方法较慢但基本不会失败。因此我们选择三维 Newton-Raphson 作为默认，并以一维 Ridders 方法作为安全“降落伞”。
classification.one_liner: SPHINCS_BSSN 针对表格状态方程开发三种守恒到原始变量恢复算法，推荐3D Newton-Raphson并备选1D Ridders。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文属于经典引力/数值相对论支线，涉及双中子星并合与表格状态方程的数值方法，与用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论相关；但不涉及全息对偶或量子引力。

2609.26834v2.title: Twin Universes and Bimetric Gravity: From Sakharov's Cosmological Symmetry to Modern Speculations on Negative Mass
2609.26834v2.abstract: We review the conceptual and theoretical status of twin-universe models, from Sakharov's early ideas on baryogenesis, CPT symmetry, and reversed arrows of time to recent quantum-cosmological scenarios involving pair-created entangled universes. Particular attention is given to the distinction between Sakharov-type cosmological symmetry, modern bimetric theories of gravity, and speculative models involving negative mass sectors. We summarize the main consistency conditions faced by bimetric gravity, including the Boulware-Deser ghost, Higuchi-type bounds, covariant conservation laws, and no-go results for positive- and negative-mass sectors. We then examine the Janus cosmological model and related black-hole replacement proposals, emphasizing the difference between heuristic twin-universe narratives and fully specified relativistic field theories. We argue that while twin-universe ideas remain a fertile framework for questions about the arrow of time, matter-antimatter asymmetry, and the quantum origin of the universe, models combining bimetric gravity, negative mass, dark-sector phenomenology, and alternatives to Kerr black holes face a substantial burden of mathematical and observational proof.

classification.title_zh: 孪生宇宙与双度规引力：从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到关于负质量的现代思辨
classification.abstract_zh: 本文综述孪生宇宙模型的概念与理论现状：从萨哈罗夫关于重子生成、CPT对称性和时间箭头反转的早期思想，到近期涉及成对产生纠缠宇宙的量子宇宙学情景。特别关注萨哈罗夫型宇宙学对称性、现代双度规引力理论与涉及负质量部门的思辨模型之间的区别。我们总结双度规引力面临的主要自洽性条件，包括Boulware-Deser鬼、Higuchi型界限、协变守恒律，以及正质量与负质量部门的不可能性结果。随后考察Janus宇宙学模型及相关的黑洞替代方案，强调启发式孪生宇宙叙事与完整指定的相对论场论之间的差异。我们认为，尽管孪生宇宙思想对于时间箭头、物质-反物质不对称和宇宙量子起源等问题仍是有成果的框架，但将双度规引力、负质量、暗部门现象学与Kerr黑洞替代方案结合起来的模型仍面临沉重的数学与观测证明负担。
classification.one_liner: 综述从萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性到现代双度规引力与负质量孪生宇宙模型，并讨论其自洽性条件与黑洞替代方案。
keywords: 萨哈罗夫宇宙学对称性
classification.relevance_reason: 主题涉及经典引力与宇宙学，匹配用户重点标签中的经典引力/广义相对论，但非全息或量子引力核心，因此中等相关。

2610.02420v1.title: High Energy Neutrinos, Gravitational Waves, and Dark Matter from a Cosmological First Order Phase Transition
2610.02420v1.abstract: We investigate high energy neutrinos (HE$\nu$s) from the decay of superheavy dark matter (DM) produced during a cosmological first order phase transition. Adopting the filtered DM production mechanism, we revisit the relic abundance calculation by incorporating recent progress in determining the bubble wall velocity from hydrodynamics. We show that DM with mass $m_{\text{DM}}\simeq 4.4\times10^{8}~\text{GeV}$ can reproduce the observed relic abundance and accommodate ultra high energy neutrino events such as KM3-230213A, while the same phase transition simultaneously generates a stochastic gravitational wave (GW) background. Although the GW signal (which peaks at $10^{4}\,\text{Hz}$) is not yet observable in this example, at lower DM masses $m_{\text{DM}} \lesssim10^{6}~\text{GeV}$, the neutrino spectrum shifts into the energy range relevant for IceCube observations, while the associated GW signal moves to lower frequencies and can reach the projected sensitivities of Cosmic Explorer, BBO, and DECIGO. This gives a multimessenger connection between HE$\nu$s and GWs, with both signals connected to DM production in a first order phase transition.

classification.title_zh: 来自宇宙学一阶相变的高能中微子、引力波与暗物质
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究由宇宙学一阶相变中产生的超重暗物质（DM）衰变而来的高能中微子（HEνs）。采用过滤暗物质产生机制，我们结合从流体力学确定气泡壁速度的最新进展，重新考察了遗迹丰度计算。我们表明，质量 m_DM≈4.4×10^8 GeV 的暗物质可以再现观测到的遗迹丰度，并容纳如 KM3-230213A 这样的超高能中微子事件，而同一相变同时产生随机引力波（GW）背景。尽管在此例子中 GW 信号（峰值在 10^4 Hz）尚不可观测，但在较低 DM 质量 m_DM≲10^6 GeV 时，中微子谱移入与 IceCube 观测相关的能量范围，同时相关 GW 信号移到较低频率，并可达到 Cosmic Explorer、BBO 和 DECIGO 的预期灵敏度。这给出了 HEνs 与 GWs 之间的多信使联系，两种信号都与一阶相变中的 DM 产生相关。
classification.one_liner: 一阶宇宙相变中过滤产生的超重暗物质可同时解释超高能中微子事件并产生随机引力波信号，形成暗物质-中微子-引力波多信使联系。
classification.relevance_reason: 非全息/AdS/CFT 论文，但涉及宇宙学一阶相变、气泡成核与随机引力波，并给出中微子-引力波-暗物质多信使联系，匹配重点标签“相变与气泡成核”和“经典引力/广义相对论”。

2610.03148v1.title: Twins in the Shadow: Phase Transitions in Proto-Neutron Stars
2610.03148v1.abstract: We study the impact of a first-order phase transition from hadronic to deconfined quark matter on the evolution of proto-neutron stars. To maximize the applicability of our results, we construct an equation of state that is highly parameterizable, where we use a relativistic mean field approach to model hadronic matter and a constant speed of sound approach to model quark matter. We approximate the cooling behavior of proto-neutron stars as a sequence of decreasing entropy at constant baryonic mass. Some parameterizations lead to so-called "twin-stars", where two neutron stars have the same (gravitational) mass but different radii. Detecting them is regarded as a smoking gun signal for phase transition. We find, however, that proto-neutron star evolution suggests that gravitational twin stars are only possible if the hybrid star does not have, in addition, a baryonic twin. This rules out most twin star pairs, especially if the phase transition occurs at large densities. In a mass-radius diagram the unpopulated hybrid branch appears to be "in the shadow" of the hadronic branch.

classification.title_zh: 阴影中的孪生星：原中子星中的相变
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究从强子物质到退禁闭夸克物质的一阶相变对原中子星演化的影响。为最大化结果的适用性，我们构建了高度可参数化的状态方程，其中用相对论平均场方法描述强子物质，用常数声速方法描述夸克物质。我们将原中子星的冷却行为近似为在固定重子质量下熵递减的序列。某些参数化会导致所谓“孪生星”，即两颗中子星具有相同（引力）质量但半径不同；探测到它们被视为相变的决定性信号。然而我们发现，原中子星演化表明，引力孪生星只有在杂化星不额外具有重子孪生星时才可能；这排除了大多数孪生星对，尤其是当相变发生在高密度时。在质量-半径图中，未被占据的杂化支看起来处于强子支的“阴影”中。
classification.one_liner: 原中子星演化对一阶强子-夸克相变产生的引力孪生星施加限制，多数孪生星对因重子孪生条件而被排除。
classification.relevance_reason: 与全息对偶无关；但涉及经典引力/中子星质量-半径关系及一阶相变，和“经典引力/广义相对论”“相变与气泡成核”标签部分相关。

2610.02980v1.title: Einstein--Langevin source correlations in closed non-relativistic systems
2610.02980v1.abstract: Stochastic semiclassical gravity represents stress--energy fluctuations through the Einstein--Langevin noise kernel. We examine its Newtonian projection for specified closed, particle-number-conserving non-relativistic sources and distinguish the source covariance from a reduced matter channel. The connected one-particle covariance is state dependent and differs from the universal potential-noise law postulated in the Di\'osi--Penrose model. To relate the source spectrum to dephasing, we define a separate static probe subject to a prescribed Gaussian noise law. For a finite-variance source operator in an isolated non-degenerate eigenstate, the full connected spectral measure has a gap around zero. The probe dephasing exponent is then bounded and its long-time slope vanishes. Stationary doublets can instead carry static or low-frequency spectral lines, while a specified freely spreading Gaussian source gives a finite limiting exponent. Continuum results depend on preparation, normalisation, infrared regularisation and the order of limits. We also compare coherent and incoherent many-body preparations and establish no-signalling for fixed classical-noise channels. These results identify the spatial, temporal and dynamical assumptions needed to relate source fluctuations to a matter-decoherence model. They do not exclude Markovian limits in other number-conserving non-relativistic preparations.

classification.title_zh: 封闭非相对论系统中的 Einstein–Langevin 源关联
classification.abstract_zh: 随机半经典引力通过 Einstein–Langevin 噪声核表示应力–能量涨落。我们考察其对指定的封闭、粒子数守恒的非相对论源的牛顿投影，并区分源协方差与约化物质通道。连通单粒子协方差依赖于态，且不同于 Diósi–Penrose 模型中所假设的普适势噪声律。为将源谱与退相位联系起来，我们定义了一个受指定高斯噪声律作用的独立静态探针。对于孤立非简并本征态中的有限方差源算符，完整的连通谱测度在零附近存在间隙。于是探针退相位指数有界，且其长时间斜率消失。相反，定态二重态可携带静态或低频谱线，而一个指定的自由扩展高斯源给出有限的极限指数。连续统结果依赖于制备、归一化、红外正则化以及极限顺序。我们还比较相干与非相干多体制备，并对固定经典噪声通道建立无信号性。这些结果确定了将源涨落与物质退相干模型相关联所需的空间、时间和动力学假设。它们并不排除其他粒子数守恒非相对论制备中的马尔可夫极限。
classification.one_liner: 在随机半经典引力框架中分析 Einstein–Langevin 源关联，并用静态探针将源谱与退相位联系起来，表明有限方差源在非简并本征态下谱隙导致退相位指数有界，结果依赖制备与极限顺序。
classification.relevance_reason: 论文研究随机半经典引力、Einstein-Langevin 噪声核与退相干，未涉及 AdS/CFT、全息对偶或全息方法，因此与全息分类主线相关性低。

2610.03929v1.title: Quantum covariant bit threads
2610.03929v1.abstract: Entanglement entropy plays a central role in holography. The quantum extremal surface (QES) formula is the standard tool in settings where both dynamics and bulk quantum corrections are important, such as in black hole evaporation. We derive and explore QES-equivalent prescriptions --- quantum covariant bit threads --- that formulate holographic entanglement entropy in terms of minimal or maximal bulk flows rather than extremal surfaces. Like classical covariant bit threads, our prescriptions come in two types: (typically) spacelike V-flows, and timelike U-flows. To account for bulk quantum corrections, the flow lines can start and end at points in the bulk, with the distribution of endpoints controlled by bulk entanglement entropies. In our bit thread language, the QES is a quantum bottleneck to the flow, with some threads passing through it (accounting for the area term in the generalized entropy) and others jumping across it (accounting for the entropy term). Our prescriptions provide a complementary perspective to the QES formula and offer new insights on important phenomena such as black hole evaporation, islands, and baby universes.

classification.title_zh: 量子协变比特线
classification.abstract_zh: 纠缠熵在全息中起核心作用。量子极值面（QES）公式是在动力学与体量子修正都重要的情形（如黑洞蒸发）中的标准工具。我们推导并探索了与 QES 等价的方案——量子协变比特线——它用体的极小或极大流，而不是极值面，来表述全息纠缠熵。与经典协变比特线一样，我们的方案有两种类型：（通常）类空的 V-流和类时的 U-流。为了计入体量子修正，流线可以在体中的点开始和结束，端点的分布由体纠缠熵控制。在我们的比特线语言中，QES 是流的量子瓶颈，一些线穿过它（对应广义熵中的面积项），另一些线跳过它（对应熵项）。我们的方案为 QES 公式提供了互补视角，并为黑洞蒸发、岛和婴儿宇宙等重要现象提供了新见解。
classification.one_liner: 提出量子协变比特线方案，用体的极小/极大流等价表述量子极值面与全息纠缠熵，并将 QES 视为流的量子瓶颈。

2610.04065v1.title: Wilson line defect indices for M2-brane SCFTs
2610.04065v1.abstract: We investigate line defect Coulomb and Higgs indices in 3d $\mathcal{N}\ge 4$ supersymmetric gauge theories. The normalized line defect indices defined by ratios of the decorated defect indices to the ordinary indices yield well-defined integer values, the line defect Witten indices in the unit R-charge fugacity limit. We propose general formulae for these Witten indices in both Coulomb and Higgs limits for the theories without Chern-Simons terms, and we show that both count the states invariant under the residual gauge group left unbroken at a generic point of the branch, which we read off from the vacuum equations. Furthermore, we find powerful algebraic recursion relations for Wilson line defect Coulomb indices in the 3d SCFTs describing M2-branes, including ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories. These relations imply that higher rank line defect indices are recursively determined by lower rank data across $U(N)$, $USp(2N)$, $SO(2N)$ and $SO(2N+1)$ ADHM-type theories and ABJ(M) theories.

classification.title_zh: M2-膜 SCFT 的 Wilson 线缺陷指标
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 3d N≥4 超对称规范理论中的线缺陷 Coulomb 和 Higgs 指标。由修饰缺陷指标与普通指标之比定义的归一化线缺陷指标给出良好定义的整数值，即在单位 R-荷逸度极限下的线缺陷 Witten 指标。我们为无 Chern-Simons 项的理论提出 Coulomb 和 Higgs 极限下这些 Witten 指标的通用公式，并证明二者都计数在分支一般点处残余规范群下不变的态，该残余规范群由真空方程读出。此外，我们在描述 M2-膜的 3d SCFT（包括 ADHM 型理论和 ABJ(M) 理论）中，发现 Wilson 线缺陷 Coulomb 指标的强有力代数递推关系。这些关系意味着更高阶线缺陷指标由低阶数据递归决定，适用于 U(N)、USp(2N)、SO(2N) 和 SO(2N+1) ADHM 型理论以及 ABJ(M) 理论。
classification.one_liner: 研究 3d N≥4 规范理论中 Wilson 线缺陷的 Coulomb/Higgs 指标，并在 M2-膜 SCFT 中发现递推关系。

2610.04218v1.title: Higher-form Symmetries of Linearized Gravity in Maximally Symmetric Spaces
2610.04218v1.abstract: We formulate the gravitational field on maximally symmetric spacetimes as a gauge theory, and investigate higher-form symmetries of the linearized gravitational field via a series expansion in Newton's gravitational constant. To treat gravity as a gauge theory, the MacDowell-Mansouri formulation based on Cartan geometry is utilized. We show the existence of a 1-form symmetry in linearized gravity on Minkowski spacetime. Furthermore, for other maximally symmetric spacetimes (de Sitter and anti-de Sitter spacetimes) with a small cosmological constant, we demonstrate the existence of an approximate 1-form symmetry in the corresponding linearized gravity, detailing its explicit dependence on the cosmological constant.

classification.title_zh: 最大对称空间中线性化引力的高形式对称性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们将最大对称时空上的引力场表述为规范理论，并通过对牛顿引力常数作级数展开来研究线性化引力场的高形式对称性。为了把引力作为规范理论处理，采用了基于 Cartan 几何的 MacDowell-Mansouri 表述。我们证明了闵可夫斯基时空上线性化引力中 1-形式对称性的存在。此外，对于具有小宇宙学常数的其他最大对称时空（de Sitter 和 anti-de Sitter 时空），我们证明了相应线性化引力中存在近似的 1-形式对称性，并详细给出了其对宇宙学常数的显式依赖。
classification.one_liner: 将最大对称时空中的线性化引力表述为基于 Cartan 几何的 MacDowell-Mansouri 规范理论，并发现闵氏时空中的 1-形式对称性及 dS/AdS 小宇宙学常数下的近似 1-形式对称性。

2610.04476v1.title: Wald entropy and Wen-Zee type gauge-curvature coupling in 2+1-dimensional gravity
2610.04476v1.abstract: The Wen-Zee term is a mixed gauge-curvature coupling in the topological Chern-Simons description of a quantum Hall fluid, encoding the electric charge bound to spatial curvature. We investigate a Lorentz-covariant generalisation of this coupling, expanding its scope to black-hole spacetimes and determine its contribution to horizon entropy. Such a coupling arises naturally in three-dimensional Chern-Simons gravity based on the Maxwell algebra. We show that its Wald entropy contribution is a horizon boost charge, given by a loop integral of the additional gauge field projected along the tangent to the bifurcation circle. This contribution can be nonzero even when the mixed term vanishes on shell. We show that the integral admits an Abelian holonomy interpretation when the projection direction is covariantly constant. We evaluate the charge on a flat cosmological solution and, using smooth horizon fields and a specified thermal ensemble, on an AdS-Lorentz black hole. These results connect the geometric response familiar from quantum Hall physics to gravitational horizon thermodynamics.

classification.title_zh: 2+1维引力中的Wald熵与Wen-Zee型规范-曲率耦合
classification.abstract_zh: Wen-Zee项是量子霍尔流体的拓扑Chern-Simons描述中的一种混合规范-曲率耦合，编码了束缚于空间曲率的电荷。我们研究该耦合的洛伦兹协变化推广，将其范围扩展至黑洞时空，并确定其对视界熵的贡献。此类耦合自然出现在基于Maxwell代数的三维Chern-Simons引力中。我们证明其Wald熵贡献是一个视界助推荷，由附加规范场沿分叉圆切向投影的环路积分给出。即使混合项在壳消失，该贡献也可以非零。当投影方向协变常时，该积分具有Abelian holonomy解释。我们在平直宇宙学解上计算该荷，并利用光滑视界场和指定热系综在AdS-Lorentz黑洞上计算该荷。这些结果将量子霍尔物理中熟悉的几何响应与引力视界热力学联系起来。
classification.one_liner: 在2+1维Chern-Simons引力中，Wen-Zee型混合规范-曲率耦合对Wald熵的贡献表现为视界助推荷，并在平直宇宙学解与AdS-Lorentz黑洞上计算。

2610.05208v1.title: From Critical Zero Modes to Interior Dynamics in Holographic Superconductors
2610.05208v1.abstract: We study how the critical behavior of holographic superconductors controls the interior geometry of charged black holes. Although the exterior condensate vanishes at criticality, the critical zero mode develops logarithmic oscillations near the Reissner--Nordstr\"om Cauchy horizon, rendering the interior critical limit nonuniform. We show that the transmitted critical-mode amplitude, together with local Cauchy-horizon quantities, fixes both the leading Einstein--Rosen collapse $\Delta z_{\rm ER}$ width and the phase $\Theta_J$ in the subsequent Josephson regime. If the condensate obeys $t\equiv1-T/T_c\propto\epsilon^{2r}$, then $\Delta z_{\rm ER}\propto t^{1/r}$ and $\Theta_J\propto t^{-1/r}$. This Josephson phase is transferred to the first Kasner epoch, producing oscillatory Kasner exponents and an accumulation law $t_n\sim n^{-r}$ for successive zeros of the scalar velocity. The critical zero mode fixes the leading collapse and phase coefficients, which are quantitatively confirmed by fully nonlinear solutions in both the ordinary and tricritical cases. At low temperature, the interior instead depends on the infrared completion of the zero-temperature geometry. Thus near-critical scaling is governed by critical-mode transmission, whereas the low-temperature behavior is controlled by the infrared endpoint.

classification.title_zh: 从临界零模到全息超导体的内部动力学
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究全息超导体的临界行为如何控制带电黑洞的内部几何。尽管外部凝聚在临界点消失，临界零模在Reissner-Nordström Cauchy视界附近产生对数振荡，使得内部临界极限非一致。我们表明，透射的临界模振幅与局部Cauchy视界量共同决定了主导的Einstein-Rosen坍缩宽度Δz_ER以及后续Josephson区域中的相位Θ_J。若凝聚满足 t≡1-T/T_c∝ε^{2r}，则 Δz_ER∝t^{1/r}，Θ_J∝t^{-1/r}。该Josephson相位被转移到第一个Kasner epoch，产生振荡的Kasner指数以及标量速度相继零点的累积律 t_n∼n^{-r}。临界零模确定了主导坍缩和相位系数，并在普通和三临界情形下由完全非线性解定量证实。在低温下，内部则依赖于零温几何的红外完成。因此，近临界标度由临界模透射控制，而低温行为由红外端点控制。
classification.one_liner: 全息超导临界零模通过透射控制带电黑洞内部ER坍缩与Josephson/Kasner动力学，低温行为则由红外端点决定。

2610.05460v1.title: Extremal black hole throats from non extremal near horizon expansions
2610.05460v1.abstract: We show how extremal near horizon geometries can be recovered from the non extremal near horizon expansion for smooth stationary black hole families admitting a smooth extremal limit. In Gaussian null coordinates common to the family, we apply the near extremal scaling of the surface gravity together with a radial scaling and a rescaling of Killing time. Although the physical surface gravity vanishes, the scaled horizon can retain a finite surface gravity. The extremal near horizon geometry is obtained when this scaled surface gravity is taken to zero. Under the near extremal scaling and the time rescaling, the quadratic radial term in the temporal metric component can survive, while higher radial orders vanish. Expansion through second order is therefore sufficient and is necessary whenever the quadratic term has a nonzero limiting coefficient in the chosen chart. We derive a common pullback prescription for extracting the near horizon coefficients and recover the known throats of Reissner-Nordstr\"om, Kerr, Kerr-Newman, and charged rotating Ba\~nados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) black holes. Neutral rotating BTZ provides a case in which the string Carroll expansion already suffices.

classification.title_zh: 从非极端近地平展开得到极端黑洞喉部
classification.abstract_zh: 我们展示了，对于具有光滑极端极限的光滑稳态黑洞族，如何从非极端近地平展开恢复极端近地平几何。在族共有的 Gaussian null 坐标中，我们对表面引力作近极端缩放，并结合径向缩放和 Killing 时间重标度。尽管物理表面引力消失，缩放后的地平可以保留有限表面引力。当这一缩放表面引力趋于零时，就得到极端近地平几何。在近极端缩放和时间重标度下，时间度规分量中的二次径向项可以存活，而更高径向阶消失。因此，展开到二阶既充分，又在所选图中二次项具有非零极限系数时必要。我们推导了用于提取近地平系数的统一拉回方案，并恢复了 Reissner-Nordström、Kerr、Kerr-Newman 以及带电旋转 Bañados-Teitelboim-Zanelli (BTZ) 黑洞的已知喉部。中性旋转 BTZ 提供了一个弦 Carroll 展开已经足够的例子。
classification.one_liner: 该文建立坐标缩放与拉回方法，从非极端近地平展开恢复极端黑洞近地平喉部几何。

2610.05760v1.title: More on the Celestial Soft Symmetry Algebra in the ${\cal N}=8$ Supergravity
2610.05760v1.abstract: We construct the operator product expansions (OPEs) of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ currents (obtained from the antiholomorphic light transform) with the matter fields in the ${\cal N}=8$ supergravity. The corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained from the double contour integrals using the above OPEs. By computing the triple (anti)commutators consisting of current-current-matter (i.e., the Jacobi identity for fixed last element), the previously known ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the antiholomorphic sector) is reproduced. We repeat the above procedure by taking the holomorphic light transform and the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ currents with the matter fields and the corresponding (anti)commutators are obtained. We also obtain another type of ${\cal N}=8$ celestial soft symmetry algebra between these currents (in the holomorphic sector). As a subalgebra in the antiholomorphic and holomorphic sectors, there exists the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS (Bondi, van der Burg, Metzner, and Sachs in 1962) algebra. We analyze the above results from the ${\cal N}=8$ conformally {\it soft} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents in the antiholomorphic (or holomorphic) sector. The nontrivial soft theorems for the graviton, the gravitinos and the graviphotons are described. Finally, using the shadow transform (the consecutive composition of holomorphic and antiholomorphic light transforms), we obtain the OPEs of the ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ (or ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$) currents with the matter fields where the stress-energy tensor, the supercurrents and the supertranslation generator of the ${\cal N}=8$ extended BMS algebra are identified.

classification.title_zh: N=8 超引力中天球软对称代数的进一步研究
classification.abstract_zh: 我们构造了 ${\cal N}=8$ 超引力中（由反全纯光变换得到的）${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$ 流与物质场的算子乘积展开（OPEs）。利用上述 OPE，通过双重围道积分得到相应的（反）对易子。通过计算由流-流-物质组成的三重（反）对易子（即固定最后一个元素的 Jacobi 恒等式），复现了先前已知的、这些流之间（在反全纯部分）的 ${\cal N}=8$ 天球软对称代数。我们对全纯光变换以及 ${\cal N}=8$ ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$ 流与物质场的 OPE 重复上述过程，得到相应的（反）对易子。我们还得到这些流之间（在全纯部分）的另一类 ${\cal N}=8$ 天球软对称代数。作为反全纯与全纯部分中的子代数，存在 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS（Bondi、van der Burg、Metzner 和 Sachs，1962）代数。我们从反全纯（或全纯）部分中的 ${\cal N}=8$ 共形{\it 软} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）流来分析上述结果。描述了引力子、引力微子和引力光子的非平凡软定理。最后，利用 shadow 变换（全纯与反全纯光变换的连续复合），我们得到 ${\cal N}=8$ {\it shadow} ${\rm w}_{1+\infty}$（或 ${\rm \bar{w}}_{1+\infty}$）流与物质场的 OPE，其中识别出 ${\cal N}=8$ 扩展 BMS 代数的应力-能量张量、超流（supercurrents）和超平移生成元。
classification.one_liner: 本文通过 N=8 超引力中 w_{1+∞} 流与物质场的 OPE 与三重（反）对易子，构造全纯/反全纯天球软对称代数，并识别其 N=8 扩展 BMS 子代数及软定理、shadow 变换结构。

2610.05798v1.title: Einstein--Maxwell Sum Rules and the Persistence of the Smooth-Brane No-Go Theorem
2610.05798v1.abstract: We investigate whether a minimally coupled Abelian Maxwell sector can relax the Gibbons--Kallosh--Linde (GKL) obstruction to smooth five-dimensional warped braneworlds. For a canonical scalar field coupled to a bulk Maxwell field, we derive the one-parameter family of global consistency conditions while keeping the tangential F_{{\mu}{\nu}} and mixed F_{{\mu}5} sectors separate. This decomposition is essential because the Maxwell stress tensor is not traceless in five dimensions. We show that electromagnetic terms formally modify the integrated GKL constraints, but this modification does not provide a consistent evasion of the no-go theorem under the standard assumptions. Exact four-dimensional Poincar\'e invariance excludes a nonzero deterministic classical Maxwell field from the background, since its field strength would select preferred four-dimensional directions. The Maxwell sector therefore vanishes in the symmetric background and the usual smooth-brane obstruction is recovered. We also identify which assumptions must be relaxed for a nontrivial electromagnetic contribution and distinguish this background result from local consistency conditions for bulk gauge-field localization.
authors: Paulo Michel Longo Tavares da Silva

classification.title_zh: Einstein-Maxwell 求和规则与光滑膜禁戒定理的持续
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究最小耦合阿贝尔 Maxwell 部门是否能够缓解 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde (GKL) 对五维光滑翘曲膜世界的阻碍。对于与体 Maxwell 场耦合的正则标量场，我们在将切向 F_{\mu\nu} 和混合 F_{\mu5} 部门分开的情况下，推导了单参数族整体一致性条件。这种分解至关重要，因为 Maxwell 应力张量在五维中并非无迹。我们表明电磁项在形式上修正了积分 GKL 约束，但在标准假设下这种修正不能提供对禁戒定理的一致规避。精确的四维 Poincaré 不变性排除了背景中非零确定性经典 Maxwell 场，因为其场强会选出优先的四维方向。因此 Maxwell 部门在对称背景中消失，通常的光滑膜阻碍重新出现。我们还指出了哪些假设必须被放松才能得到非平庸的电磁贡献，并将此背景结果与体规范场局域化的局域一致性条件区分开。
classification.one_liner: 在标准假设下，阿贝尔 Maxwell 场不能规避五维光滑翘曲膜世界的 GKL 禁戒定理。

2610.05821v1.title: Global Consistency of Cosmological Braneworlds in Palatini and Metric-Affine f(R) Gravity
2610.05821v1.abstract: We investigate global consistency conditions for five-dimensional warped braneworlds in Palatini and metric-affine gravity. Starting from the generalized Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde framework, we derive integrated sum rules for cosmological warped geometries and examine how independent connection degrees of freedom modify the standard Einstein-gravity obstruction to smooth compact braneworlds. The analysis separates geometric, matter, and non-Riemannian contributions and clarifies the conditions under which the usual no-go result can be modified. We show that the generalized consistency relations provide necessary global constraints on admissible configurations and identify the terms responsible for possible departures from the Riemannian case. The results establish a systematic framework for testing the global consistency of smooth five-dimensional braneworlds in gravitational theories with independent affine structure.
authors: Paulo Michel L. T da Silva

classification.title_zh: Palatini 与度量仿射 f(R) 引力中宇宙学膜世界的全局一致性
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究 Palatini 与度量仿射引力中五维弯曲膜世界的全局一致性条件。从广义 Gibbons-Kallosh-Linde 框架出发，我们推导了宇宙学弯曲几何的积分求和规则，并考察独立联络自由度如何改变标准 Einstein 引力对光滑紧致膜世界的障碍。分析将几何、物质和非黎曼贡献分开，并澄清了通常 no-go 结果可被修改的条件。我们证明广义一致性关系为允许构型提供了必要的全局约束，并确定了导致偏离黎曼情形可能的项。结果建立了一个系统性框架，用于检验具有独立仿射结构的引力理论中光滑五维膜世界的全局一致性。
classification.one_liner: 研究 Palatini/度量仿射 f(R) 引力下五维弯曲膜世界的全局一致性条件与求和规则，分析非黎曼联络如何改变 Einstein 引力对光滑紧致膜世界的障碍。

2610.05946v1.title: Black Hole Entropy and Holographic Entanglement Entropy in DGP Brane Gravity
2610.05946v1.abstract: We investigate the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity with gravitational dynamics localized on the brane. We first consider the DGP brane model, in which an Einstein-Hilbert term is included in the brane action, and derive the condition under which the gravitational entropy of a braneworld black hole agrees with the holographic entanglement entropy. We show that the two entropies coincide when a specific condition involving the extrinsic curvature of the brane is satisfied. In particular, this condition is automatically satisfied for static configurations. We then generalize the brane-localized Einstein-Hilbert term to higher-curvature gravitational theories. For Lovelock gravity and $f(R)$ gravity on the brane, we derive the corresponding conditions for the equality between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy and show that they take the same form as that obtained for Einstein gravity. Although the equality is not guaranteed for general stationary configurations, the required condition is satisfied for static braneworld black holes, leading to an agreement between the two entropies. These results clarify the relation between gravitational entropy and holographic entanglement entropy in braneworld gravity and contribute to a deeper understanding of holography in braneworld settings.

classification.title_zh: DGP膜引力中的黑洞熵与全息纠缠熵
classification.abstract_zh: 我们研究引力熵与全息纠缠熵在膜世界引力中的关系，其中引力动力学定域在膜上。首先考虑DGP膜模型，即在膜作用量中包含Einstein-Hilbert项，推导膜世界黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵一致所需的条件。我们表明，当涉及膜外曲率的一个特定条件满足时，两种熵相等；特别地，该条件对静态构型自动满足。随后将膜局域Einstein-Hilbert项推广到高阶曲率引力理论。对于膜上的Lovelock引力和$f(R)$引力，我们推导引力熵与全息纠缠熵相等对应的条件，并表明它们与Einstein引力所得形式相同。尽管对一般稳态构型等式并不保证成立，但所需条件对静态膜世界黑洞满足，从而使两种熵一致。这些结果阐明了膜世界引力中引力熵与全息纠缠熵的关系，并有助于更深入理解膜世界设定中的全息。
classification.one_liner: 在DGP等膜世界引力中，黑洞的引力熵与全息纠缠熵在静态膜世界黑洞构型下满足特定外曲率条件时相等。

2610.06470v1.title: A local second law for black hole dynamics in the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm
2610.06470v1.abstract: The large-$D$ membrane paradigm provides a perturbative, non-gravitational description of black hole dynamics. While the local second law of thermodynamics has been established for neutral membranes, the explicit determination of the local entropy production equation within the charged large-$D$ membrane framework remains unsolved. In this paper, we compute the subleading-order correction to the divergence of the membrane velocity for a charged black hole in a flat background. We evaluate the corresponding scalar Einstein-Maxwell constraint equation at the physical event horizon via the non-affine null Raychaudhuri equation, and relate the physical horizon expressions to the auxiliary membrane kinematics, demonstrating that the membrane velocity produces a non-negative divergence at the first non-vanishing order in the membrane worldvolume, which is driven by two quadratic forms: the membrane shear and a novel contribution generated purely by the Maxwell field. Using this result, we construct the membrane entropy current and prove that its divergence is non-negative through this order, thereby establishing the local second law for the charged large-$D$ membrane paradigm.

classification.title_zh: 带电大 D 膜范式中黑洞动力学的局部第二定律
classification.abstract_zh: 大 D 膜范式为黑洞动力学提供了一种微扰的非引力描述。虽然中性膜的局部热力学第二定律已经建立，但在带电大 D 膜框架中显式确定局部熵产生方程仍未解决。本文计算了平直背景下带电黑洞膜速度散度的次领头阶修正。我们通过非仿射零 Raychaudhuri 方程，在物理事件视界上计算相应的标量 Einstein-Maxwell 约束方程，并将物理视界表达式与辅助膜运动学联系起来，证明膜速度在膜世界体积的第一个非零阶产生非负散度，该散度由两个二次形式驱动：膜剪切以及纯 Maxwell 场产生的新贡献。利用这一结果，我们构造了膜熵流，并证明其散度到该阶非负，从而建立了带电大 D 膜范式的局部第二定律。
classification.one_liner: 在带电大 D 膜范式中计算膜速度散度的次领头阶修正，并构造具有非负散度的熵流，证明局部第二定律。
